Here plate 8.6.1 «Method of parking the vehicle» makes the sign apply to ALL vehicles. It specifies how they must be positioned in the parking area in the local widening of the carriageway. The driver of car «Б» breaks the parking rules. (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.2)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What do you do?
Stop before the stop line
Continue, giving way to the passenger car
Continue, having priority over the passenger car

The intersection is regulated. You continue on the additional section (arrow) switched on together with the main red signal, without stopping at the stop line. But while doing so you must give way to all vehicles coming from other directions. If you obstruct one, you create a dangerous situation that may turn into an accident, and you will be at fault. (ПДД clauses 13.3, 13.5)
How should you act when turning right?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the passenger car
Give way to the passenger car and the motorcycle

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. The motorcyclist and the passenger car have an obstruction on their right. You have none, so you go through the intersection first, the passenger car second and the motorcyclist last. (ПДД clause 13.11)
If it is impossible to tell whether the road is paved (darkness, mud, snow, etc.) and there are no priority signs:
You may assume you are on the priority road
You should assume you are on a road of equal status
You must assume you are on the secondary road
If the driver cannot tell whether the road is paved (darkness, mud, snow, etc.) and there are no priority signs, he must assume he is on the secondary road. (Road signs, ПДД clause 13.13)
In this situation you:
Must give way to the bus moving off from the marked stop
Have priority, since the bus is moving off into the left lane

In built-up areas marked with the corresponding sign on a white background, buses and trolleybuses moving off from a marked stop have priority. Their drivers may move off only after making sure they are being given way. This clause of the Rules is a rare case where the drivers share equal responsibility for resolving the situation. (ПДД clause 18.3)
Which external lights must be switched on on towed motor vehicles in the hours of darkness and in conditions of insufficient visibility, whatever the road lighting, and also in tunnels?
Daytime running lights
Side lights
Rear fog lights

In the hours of darkness and in conditions of insufficient visibility, whatever the road lighting, and also in tunnels, on trailers and towed motor vehicles the side lights must be switched on. (ПДД clause 19.1)
The driving licence of a driver who has committed an administrative offence is taken away:
When the offence is detected and stopped
Immediately after the ruling on disqualification from driving is issued
After the ruling on disqualification from driving has come into legal force

The driving licence of a driver who has committed an administrative offence is taken away after the ruling on disqualification from driving has come into legal force. (КоАП art. 31.1 cl. 1, art. 31.2 part 2, art. 32.6 part 1)
To stop a skid caused by braking, the driver must first of all:
Stop braking
Disengage the clutch
Continue braking without changing the pressure on the brake pedal

A skid during braking is caused either by the brakes not acting at the same time or by the wheels locking. You must immediately unlock the wheels, i.e. release the brake pedal, and try to straighten the car. (Vehicle driving technique)
What must be done to remove a foreign body from a casualty's airway?
Lay the casualty face down across your knee and hit him on the back several times with your fist

Induce vomiting by pressing on the root of the tongue. If this does not work, hit the casualty on the back with the edge of your palm, or stand in front of him and press hard on his abdomen with your fist.

Stand at the casualty's side, supporting him with one hand under the chest, and with the other hand tilt his body forward, head down. Give five sharp blows with the base of the palm between the shoulder blades. If this does not work, stand behind him, put both arms around him just above the navel, clasp your hands and press sharply five times on the abdomen, inwards and upwards.

Signs of a foreign body in the airway: noisy, difficult breathing and inability to speak. To remove it, remember that first you stand at the casualty's side, supporting him with one hand under the chest, and with the other hand tilt his body forward, head down. Only then do you hit him several times with your palm on the back, between the shoulder blades. Then act as described in the correct answer.
Which conditions are mandatory for completing the paperwork on a road traffic accident without authorised police officers?
As a result of the interaction (collision) of two vehicles (including their trailers), damage was caused only to them
The civil liability of the vehicle owners is insured in accordance with the law
The circumstances of the damage to the vehicles, and the nature and list of visible damage, are recorded in accordance with the compulsory insurance rules
All of the listed conditions

According to ПДД clause 2.6.1 and Article 11.1 part 1 of the Federal Law «On Compulsory Insurance of Civil Liability of Vehicle Owners», drivers involved in an accident may complete the accident paperwork without authorised police officers if all the conditions listed in the answers are met. (Wording of the question and answers updated on 14.12.18)
May you drive into the courtyard beyond the intersection?
Yes
Yes, if you live in this building
No

When sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead» is placed before an intersection of carriageways, it applies only to the first intersection beyond the sign. The left turn is made outside the sign's zone. Nothing prohibits it. You drive into the courtyard along the path shown. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to stop beyond the sign?
Allowed
Allowed only to pick up (drop off) a passenger
Prohibited
Plate 8.2.4 «Zone of effect» under sign 3.27 «No stopping» shows that the prohibitory sign applies both before and after the sign. So the Rules prohibit stopping at the indicated place. (Road signs)
Which of these signs prohibit going on without stopping?
А and Г
Б and В
В and Г
All of them
Passing without stopping is prohibited by sign «Б» 3.17.1 «Customs» and sign «В» 3.17.3 «Control». (Road signs)
What must you follow if the white and orange marking lines on the carriageway contradict each other?
The white marking lines
The orange marking lines
The Rules do not cover this situation
Permanent markings are white. Temporary markings are orange. When temporary and permanent marking lines contradict each other, drivers must follow the temporary lines. (Horizontal road markings)
You intended to drive straight through the intersection. What should you do if you did not move into the left lane in time?
Stop before the stop line and wait for the green light
Drive past the stop line, move into the left lane and stop before the intersecting carriageway
Turn right
Here there is nothing you can do. Both sign 5.15.1 «Lane directions» and the traffic light with an additional section oblige you to turn right from the rightmost lane. (Road signs, ПДД clause 6.3)
Which sign is used to mark a vehicle after a forced stop in places where, given the visibility, other drivers cannot see it in time?
А
Б
В
The warning triangle (emergency stop sign) «А». (ПДД clause 7.2)
You may turn left:
Only along path А
Only along path Б
Along either of the paths shown

Sign 5.15.1 «Lane directions» allows turning left from the leftmost and the middle lane. The paths shown clearly illustrate how to do it from either lane. When turning, keep to your chosen lane. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.5)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn by reversing into the courtyard?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct other road users
Prohibited

Nothing prohibits making a U-turn this way in this situation. Reversing is prohibited at intersections, but here the adjacent territory (an entrance to a courtyard through an archway) is used. The manoeuvre must be safe and must not obstruct other road users. (ПДД clauses 1.2, 8.12)
Show the distance that the Rules call the following distance:
Only А
Only Б
Only В
А and В

Distance «Б» is the following distance between vehicles moving in the same direction. Distance «А» is the lateral clearance between oncoming vehicles, distance «В» the lateral clearance between vehicles moving in the same direction. (ПДД clause 9.10)
May you start overtaking the lorry in this situation?
Yes
Yes, only after passing the road sign
No

Here you may not start overtaking the lorry, even though the no-overtaking zone is ending. The reason: a driver may not overtake if the vehicle in front, here the lorry, is already overtaking. (ПДД clause 11.2)
Which car may be parked in the way shown on the plate?
Only a passenger car
A passenger car and a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t
Any car

Where sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» is placed with one of plates 8.6.2–8.6.9 «Method of parking the vehicle», passenger cars and motorcycles may park, and only in the way shown on the plate. All others will have to find another place to park. (Road signs)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the oncoming car
Only the pedestrians
The oncoming car and the pedestrians

The intersection is regulated. When turning left you must give way to the passenger car going straight ahead from the opposite direction and to the pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road you are turning into. (ПДД clauses 13.1, 13.4)
When turning right you should:
Give way to the passenger car
Go through the intersection first

The intersection is of equal roads. To decide the order of passage, drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You have no obstruction on your right, so you go through the intersection first. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to?
The bus and the motorcycle
The passenger car and the bus
All the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road use the same rule. The motorcyclist goes first, the bus second, then the passenger car. You go last, giving way to all vehicles. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
In this situation you must stop:
At the sign «No passing without stopping»
At the sign «Single-track railway»
5 m before the nearest rail

Sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping» is placed before the level crossing. When movement is prohibited, the driver must stop before the stop line and/or sign 6.16 «Stop line», and if there is none (as here), before sign 2.5. Driving past the sign would be a serious violation of the Rules. (Road signs, ПДД clause 15.4)
Front fog lights and rear fog lights may be switched on at the same time:
Only in fog
In conditions of insufficient visibility
In conditions of limited visibility

In conditions of «insufficient visibility» – visibility of the road of less than 300 m in fog, rain, snowfall, etc., and at twilight – front and rear fog lights may be used, according to ПДД clauses 19.4 and 19.7, separately or together. (ПДД clauses 19.4, 19.7)

What administrative enforcement measures are provided for driving a vehicle fitted with windows (including those covered with transparent tinted films) whose light transmission does not meet the requirements of the technical regulations on wheeled vehicle safety?
A fine of 500 roubles
Detention of the vehicle and a fine of 1,000 roubles
A fine of 1,500 roubles or disqualification from driving for 1 to 3 months

According to Article 12.5 part 3.1 of the КоАП РФ, for driving a vehicle fitted with windows (including those with transparent tinted films) whose light transmission does not meet the technical regulations on wheeled vehicle safety, the driver is punished only by a fine of 500 roubles.
How should emergency braking be done if the car has an anti-lock braking system?
By pressing the brake pedal intermittently
By pressing the brake pedal all the way and holding it until the car stops completely
By using the parking brake

The anti-lock braking system (ABS) is part of a modern car's brake system. ABS prevents the wheels from locking during braking, keeping the car steerable and stable, which is very important to avoid sliding and skidding, including during emergency braking. Inappropriate emergency braking can also cause an accident. So at that moment watch the situation not only ahead of you but also behind you. (Vehicle driving technique)
On which section of road is a strong crosswind most dangerous?
One sheltered by trees
When coming out of a sheltered section onto an open one
An open one
A strong crosswind is most dangerous when coming out of a sheltered section onto an open one, because the gust there can affect the car's directional stability.
Is the driver allowed to use a telephone while driving?
Allowed
Allowed only with a hands-free device
Allowed only when driving at less than 20 km/h
Prohibited
While driving, the driver is prohibited from using a telephone without a hands-free device. (ПДД clause 2.7)
This sign warns of the approach to an intersection where you:
Have the right of way
Must give way to all vehicles on the intersecting road
Must give way only to vehicles approaching from the right

At first sight this situation is very simple. Sign 1.6 «Intersection of equal roads» warns that in 50–100 m there will be an intersection of equal roads, where drivers decide the order of passage by the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right must give way (Road signs, ПДД clause 13.11). But before this intersection we see a sharp bend with limited visibility beyond it, which is the main danger for the driver, and you have not been warned about it in advance. Unfortunately, such shortcomings in traffic organisation are very common in practice and seriously affect road safety.
May you continue towing?
Only in direction А
Only in direction Б
In either of the directions shown

Sign 3.7 «No vehicles with trailers» prohibits lorries and tractors with any kind of trailer, and also towing motor vehicles. You may continue towing in direction «А». Only people who live, work or serve businesses within the sign's zone may depart from this sign. (Road signs)
Which of these signs informs you of the beginning of a road with reversible traffic?
А
Б
В
Sign «В» – 5.8 «Reversible traffic». (Road signs)
This vertical marking:
Prohibits parking
Prohibits stopping
Marks kerbs on dangerous sections of road
Vertical marking 2.7 marks kerbs on dangerous sections of road.
Are you allowed to move into the reversible-traffic lane beyond the intersection?
Allowed
Allowed if you are driving a passenger taxi
Prohibited

The reversible traffic light beyond the intersection is switched off. When the signals of the reversible traffic light above a lane marked on both sides with marking 1.9 are switched off, entering this lane is prohibited. (ПДД clause 6.7, Horizontal road markings 1.9)
This hand signal given by the passenger car driver informs you:
That he intends to turn left or make a U-turn
That he intends to stop and give way to the lorry
That a vehicle is approaching from the left
A left-turn (U-turn) signal is the left arm extended to the side (as here), or the right arm extended to the side and bent upwards at the elbow at a right angle. (ПДД clause 8.1)
When turning left to drive into a courtyard, you must give way:
Only to the cyclist
Only to the pedestrians
To the pedestrians and the cyclist
When leaving the road, the driver must give way to pedestrians and cyclists whose path he crosses. (ПДД clause 8.3)
Reversing is allowed:
At intersections
On one-way roads
On pedestrian crossings
At stops for route vehicles
Of the listed places, reversing is allowed only on a one-way road. (ПДД clause 8.12)
Driving a passenger car, may you continue on the tram tracks in the same direction?
Allowed
Allowed only to turn left or make a U-turn
Prohibited
When signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 show the number of lanes and the directions allowed from them, driving onto the tram tracks within the intersection is a violation. (ПДД clauses 8.5, 9.6)
You may start overtaking:
On the level crossing
Immediately after the level crossing
100 m after the level crossing

Overtaking is prohibited on level crossings and closer than 100 m before them. As soon as you pass the boundary of the level crossing (here the post with signs and a traffic light beyond the crossing), you may start overtaking. (ПДД clause 11.4)
Where should you park the car on the right side of the road?
Immediately before the intersection of carriageways
Immediately after the intersection of carriageways
Not closer than 5 m from the edge of the intersecting carriageway
Stopping and parking are prohibited at an intersection of carriageways and closer than 5 m from the edge of the carriageway. (ПДД clause 12.4)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the motorcycle
Only the car with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on
Both vehicles

The intersection is regulated. The priority signs «do not apply». The emergency vehicle with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on enters the intersection first on red (it may depart from traffic light signals); the others must let it pass unobstructed. When turning left you give way to the motorcyclist going straight ahead from the opposite direction. You go through the intersection last, giving way to both vehicles. (ПДД clauses 3.1, 3.2, 13.3, 13.4)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Go through the intersection at the same time as the oncoming car, before the motorcycle
Go through the intersection last

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule». You have an obstruction on your right. So does the motorcyclist. The passenger car driver has none, and his path does not cross yours. He goes first, the motorcyclist second, and you last. (ПДД clause 13.11)
How should you act when going straight ahead?
Give way to the lorry coming out of the unpaved road
Go through the intersection first

Straight ahead the road is paved. The lorry will enter the intersection from an unpaved road, which here is the secondary road. The intersection is of unequal roads. You are on the priority road, so you go through the intersection first. (ПДД clauses 1.2, term «Priority road», 13.9)
When leaving a residential zone you must give way:
Only to vehicles with a flashing beacon switched on
Only to vehicles approaching from the left
Only to vehicles approaching from the right
To all vehicles
When leaving a residential zone, drivers must give way to other road users, including all vehicles. (ПДД clause 17.3)
In the zone of which signs do the Rules allow sound signals only to prevent a road traffic accident?
Only А
Only Б
А and Б
А and В

In the zone of signs 5.23.1 and 5.23.2 «Beginning of built-up area» (on a white background) and 3.26 «No sound signals», using the horn is prohibited except to prevent a road traffic accident. (Road signs, ПДД clause 19.10)
What administrative penalties are provided for driving a vehicle when the owner's compulsory civil liability insurance knowingly does not exist?
A warning or a fine of 500 roubles
A fine of 800 roubles
A fine of 1,000 roubles or disqualification from driving for 1 to 3 months
When there is knowingly no ОСАГО (compulsory motor insurance) policy, the driver is held administratively liable under Article 12.37 part 2 of the КоАП – only a fine of 800 roubles.
Where you come out of a wooded section and the sign «Crosswind» is placed, you should:
Reduce speed and be ready for the car to deviate from its course
Without changing speed, move closer to the centre of the road
Without changing speed, move closer to the shoulder
You should reduce speed and be ready for the car to be pushed off course by the crosswind.
What are the signs of bleeding from a major artery, and how does first aid for such a wound begin?
Dark blood flows slowly from the wound. A pressure bandage is applied, with a note stating the time it was applied

Bright scarlet blood spurts or gushes from the wound in pulses. The artery is pressed with the fingers, then a haemostatic tourniquet is applied at the pressure points above the wound, as close to it as possible, with a note stating the time it was applied
Blood flows slowly from the wound. A haemostatic tourniquet is applied below the wound, with a note stating the time it was applied.

When a major artery is injured, scarlet blood spurts out in pulses with the heartbeat. The correct answer mentions that the blood is scarlet. As first aid, the artery is first pressed with the fingers, then a haemostatic tourniquet is applied at the pressure points above the wound, as close to it as possible, noting the time. A tourniquet is applied only over clothing or a cloth (bandage) pad.
How many intersections are shown in the picture?
One
Two
Four
The picture shows one four-way intersection formed by two roads crossing. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Intersection»)
Which warning and prohibitory signs are temporary?
Only those placed on portable stands
Those with a yellow background, and those placed on portable stands
Only those placed where road works are being carried out
A yellow background on warning and prohibitory signs means that these signs are temporary. Signs placed on portable stands are also temporary. (Road signs)
How must you act in this situation?
Reduce speed when passing the customs post
Stop at the customs post in 300 m
Stop at the sign and wait for the customs officers

Sign 3.17.1 «Customs» prohibits passing a customs post or customs checkpoint without stopping. Plate 8.1.1 «Distance to object» under the sign shows the distance from the sign to where the restriction applies. (Road signs)
What do these road signs mean?
Parking is allowed for emergency service vehicles
Parking is allowed only with the side lights on
Parking is allowed on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays
Plate 8.5.1 «Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays» shows that the sign it is used with applies only on these days. (Road signs)
May you cross the solid marking line that marks the edge of the carriageway?
Yes, to stop on the shoulder and to leave it
Yes, to stop on the shoulder and to leave it, only where stopping or parking is allowed
No
Marking line 1.2 may be crossed to stop a vehicle on the shoulder and to leave it, where stopping or parking is allowed. (Horizontal road markings)
In this situation the driver of the car with flashing beacons switched on:
Must wait for the permitting traffic light
May go only straight ahead or right
May go in any direction

Drivers of vehicles with a blue flashing beacon switched on, carrying out an urgent official task, may depart from traffic light signals, road signs and road markings without exception, provided traffic safety is ensured. The emergency vehicle may go in any direction it chooses. (ПДД clause 3.1)
Must you switch on the left direction indicator in this situation?
Yes
Yes, if you are going to make a U-turn
No
From the leftmost lane, according to sign 4.1.6 «Right or left», you may turn left or make a U-turn. In either case you must switch on the left direction indicator. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Along which path may you turn left?
Only А
Only Б
Along either of them
When turning out of an intersection of carriageways, you must not end up on the side for oncoming traffic. The left turn must be made along path «Б». (ПДД clause 8.6)
Is the driver allowed to reverse on the overpass to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct other road users
Prohibited

Reversing is prohibited where U-turns are prohibited and at intersections. U-turns, and therefore reversing, are not allowed on bridges and overpasses, i.e. they are prohibited. (ПДД clauses 8.11, 8.12)
Is it allowed to drive on the tram tracks for the opposite direction?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct oncoming vehicles
Allowed only when going around a tram travelling in the same direction
Prohibited
Driving onto the tram tracks for oncoming traffic is prohibited in all circumstances. (ПДД clause 9.6)
What overtaking restrictions apply on and near level crossings?
Overtaking is prohibited only on the crossing
Overtaking is prohibited on the crossing and closer than 100 m before it
Overtaking is prohibited on the crossing and within 100 m before and after it
Overtaking is prohibited on level crossings and closer than 100 metres before them. (ПДД clause 11.4)
Is the lorry driver allowed to stop at this place?
Allowed
Allowed if the lorry's permitted maximum weight is not more than 3.5 t
Prohibited

Where sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» is placed with any of plates 8.6.2, 8.6.3 and 8.6.6–8.6.9 «Method of parking the vehicle», lorries, whatever their permitted maximum weight, may not park within the zone of this combination of signs. But a lorry may stop here, i.e. stopping is allowed. (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.4)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Make the manoeuvre without stopping at the intersection
Turn left and stop in the gap in the central reservation, wait for the green light at the exit of the intersection and complete the manoeuvre
Stop before the intersection, wait for the green light at the exit of the intersection and start the manoeuvre

The green light gives you the right to go left (clause 6.2). You must then leave the intersection in the intended direction, whatever the traffic light at the exit of the intersection shows (clause 13.7).
In which case must you give way to the tram?
When turning left
When going straight ahead
In both of the listed cases
The intersection is of equal roads. Under equal conditions the tram has priority over trackless vehicles. You give way in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 13.11)
You intend to turn right. May you start turning?
Yes
Yes, once you are sure this will not obstruct the lorry
No

When turning right you must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway, i.e. use the rightmost lane, which is free. If you are sure you will not obstruct the lorry on the priority road, which has priority, you enter the intersection without waiting for it to pass, since sign 2.4 «Give way» does not require a mandatory stop before the intersection. (ПДД clauses 1.2, term «Give way», 13.9, Road signs)
Drivers must give way to other road users:
When leaving a residential zone
When leaving a courtyard area
In both of the listed cases
When leaving a residential zone or a courtyard area, drivers must give way to other road users. The correct answer: in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clauses 17.3, 17.4)
Which external lights must be switched on on a motorcycle in daylight?
Side lights
Dipped headlight or fog light
Switching on external lights on a motorcycle in daylight is not mandatory
On motorcycles and mopeds, when riding in daylight, the dipped headlight or a fog light must be switched on. (ПДД clauses 19.4, 19.5)
What is the minimum light transmission of the windscreen and of the windows giving the driver's forward view (except for armoured vehicles) at which the operation of vehicles is allowed?
75 per cent
70 per cent
60 per cent

According to clause 4.3 of the «List of faults», the minimum light transmission of the windscreen and the windows giving the driver's forward view must be 70 per cent, and for vehicles with armour protection, 60 per cent. These standards ensure road safety by giving the driver the best possible view. With less than 70 per cent light transmission, visibility at night and in bad weather is much worse and peripheral vision suffers.
Which driving style gives the lowest fuel consumption?
Sharp acceleration and smooth deceleration
Smooth acceleration and sharp deceleration
Smooth acceleration and smooth deceleration
Smooth acceleration when speeding up and smooth deceleration when braking.
If drizzle starts while you are driving on a dry asphalt-concrete road, the driver should:
Reduce speed and be especially careful
Continue without changing speed
Speed up and try to cover as much distance as possible before heavy rain starts
Raindrops mixed with dust and dirt form a «film» that sharply reduces the tyres' grip on the road and can cause a skid. At such times you must reduce speed and be attentive and careful.
How many intersections of carriageways does this intersection have?
One
Two
Four

The central reservation of the road adjoining on the right divides that road into two carriageways. Marking 1.3 (double solid line) does not do this. So this intersection has two intersections of carriageways. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Central reservation»)
This road sign:
Warns you of the approach to a crossing with a tram line
Warns you of the approach to a tram stop
Obliges you to stop immediately before the crossing with the tram line

Sign 1.5 «Crossing with a tram line» is placed in built-up areas 50–100 m before the crossing with the tram line. Keep in mind that outside intersections, where tram tracks cross the carriageway, the tram has priority over trackless vehicles, except when leaving a depot. (Road signs, ПДД clause 18.1)
These signs oblige you to keep a following distance:
Of less than 70 m over 100 m
Of not less than 70 m over 100 m
Of 70 m to 100 m

Sign 3.16 «Minimum distance limit» prohibits vehicles from driving at a distance between them shorter than shown on the sign. Plate 8.2.1 «Zone of effect» under the sign shows the zone of the sign – here 100 metres from where it is placed. (Road signs)
In which directions may you continue?
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead or left
Straight ahead, left or in the opposite direction
From the middle lane, above which sign 5.15.2 «Lane direction» is placed, you may go straight ahead and turn left. A U-turn would be allowed if the vehicle were in the leftmost lane. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to park the car at this place?
Allowed
Allowed only partly on the pavement
Prohibited
The yellow broken horizontal marking line 1.10 marks places where parking is prohibited. It is used only on its own (as here). Parking at this place is PROHIBITED. (Horizontal road markings)
You may continue:
Only along path А
Only along path Б
Along either of the paths shown

In this situation, where a traffic light with an additional section is placed before the intersection, the green arrow is on together with the main red signal, and beyond the traffic light there are several carriageways, moving on the additional section is allowed only into the first carriageway beyond the traffic light, i.e. along path «Б». (ПДД clause 6.3)
Must the driver signal with the direction indicators when moving off in a residential zone marked with the corresponding sign?
Yes
Yes, only if there are pedestrians nearby
No
Wherever you are, whether or not other vehicles are around, make it a mandatory rule for yourself to give the corresponding signal before moving off. (ПДД clause 8.1)
Along which path are you allowed to continue?
Only А
А or Б
Along any of them

Driving against the traffic (path «В») at a roundabout is prohibited. As an exception to the general rule, you may enter such an intersection from any lane of the carriageway intended for your direction (ПДД clause 8.5). When turning right, the vehicle must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway (ПДД clause 8.6). Here you can do so, so you continue along path «А».
On this section of road you are prohibited from:
Only making a U-turn
Only overtaking or going around an obstacle
Only moving into the left lane and then stopping on the shoulder
Any of the listed manoeuvres

You are on the side of the broken line of horizontal marking 1.11. It may be crossed from this side to make a U-turn, overtake or go around an obstacle. Stopping on the left side of the road outside built-up areas is prohibited. So, of the listed answers, you are prohibited from moving into the left lane and then stopping on the shoulder. (Horizontal road markings 1.11, ПДД clause 8.11)
Are you allowed to move onto the tram tracks for the opposite direction in this situation?
Allowed
Allowed only if there is no oncoming tram
Prohibited
You are driving on the tram tracks in the same direction. Moving onto the tram tracks for the opposite direction is prohibited. (ПДД clause 9.6)
In this situation you:
Must give way, since the obstacle is in your lane
Must give way, since the oncoming car is going downhill
Have the right to go first, since you are going uphill
On gradients, if there is an obstacle, the driver going downhill gives way. The passenger car driver must give way to you. (Road signs, ПДД clause 11.7)
At what distance from the sign may you park the car?
At least 5 m
At least 10 m
At least 15 m

Stopping and parking are prohibited closer than 15 m from stops for route vehicles marked with marking 1.17 (yellow zigzag), or if there is none, from the stop sign for route vehicles. In the situation shown, the distance from the front of the car must be at least 15 m. (ПДД clauses 12.4, 12.5)
What should you do in this situation if you need to turn right?
Stop and wait for another signal from the traffic controller
Turn right, giving way to the pedestrians
Turn right, having priority over the pedestrians

The traffic controller's right arm is extended forward. From his left side, trackless vehicles may go in all directions – straight ahead, right, left and U-turn. When turning right you must give way to pedestrians crossing the carriageway you are turning into. (ПДД clauses 6.10, 13.1)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. In this situation:
You must give way to the passenger car
You have the right to go through the intersection first

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. Constantly checking that there is no obstruction on your right, you go through the intersection first. (ПДД clauses 13.11, 13.12)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Both vehicles
Only the bus
Only the passenger car
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. You have an obstruction on your right – you give way to the bus. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Which of the drivers has stopped correctly to drop off passengers?
Only the driver of car А
Only the driver of car В
The drivers of cars А and Б
The drivers of cars А and В

This is in a built-up area on a section marked with sign 5.5 «One-way road». Here, as an exception, stopping on the left side of the road in the direction of travel is allowed, i.e. at place «А». You may not stop at places «В» and «Б». Place «В» is in a lane separated by a solid marking line and marked with sign 5.14.1 «Lane for route vehicles», where other vehicles may not drive or stop with this combination. Place «Б» is not at the edge of the carriageway, so stopping there is a clear violation. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 12.1, 18.2)
In which case, when driving in daylight, is it not enough to switch on the daytime running lights?
Only when visibility of the road is less than 300 m in fog, rain or snowfall
Only when driving in tunnels
In both of the listed cases

In conditions of insufficient visibility (including visibility of the road of less than 300 m in fog), main-beam or dipped headlights must be switched on; also when driving in tunnels, as the light, especially from LED daytime running lights, is not enough. The correct answer: in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 19.1)

What is required to get back a driving licence after the end of a disqualification imposed for leaving, in breach of the Road Traffic Regulations, the scene of a road traffic accident in which the driver was involved?
Only a test of the driver's knowledge of the Road Traffic Regulations
A test of the driver's knowledge of the Road Traffic Regulations and payment of the fines imposed on him for administrative road traffic offences
A test of the driver's knowledge of the Road Traffic Regulations and a medical examination for medical contraindications to driving

To get back the driving licence after a disqualification imposed for leaving the scene of an accident in which the driver was involved, he must pass a test of his knowledge of the Road Traffic Regulations and pay the fines imposed on him for administrative road traffic offences. (КоАП art. 32.6 part 4.1; art. 12.27 part 2; chapter 12)
Why is prolonged braking on a steep descent with the gear or the clutch disengaged dangerous?
Tyre tread wear increases considerably
Wear of the brake parts increases
The brakes overheat and braking becomes less effective
When the brakes overheat, the brake fluid may boil, which leads to complete brake failure.
How does the driver's field of view change as speed increases?
It widens
It does not change
It narrows
As speed increases, the driver's field of view narrows, because he has to look much further ahead to assess the rapidly changing traffic situation in time.
When driving a passenger car equipped with seat belts, who must be belted?
Only the driver
The driver and the front-seat passenger
Everyone in the car
When driving a vehicle equipped with seat belts, the driver must wear his belt and must not carry passengers who are not belted. The correct answer: everyone in the car. (ПДД clause 2.1.2)
These signs warn you:
Of the approach to a level crossing with three tracks
That there is a level crossing without a barrier in 150–300 m
That there is a level crossing in 50–100 m

Two warning signs are on one post. The lower sign 1.4.1 «Approach to a level crossing» is placed only outside built-up areas, 150–300 m before the level crossing. The upper sign 1.2 «Level crossing without barrier» is placed at the same distance outside built-up areas. This combination warns that you are approaching a level crossing without a barrier, at least 150 m away. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to park the car at this place?
Allowed
Allowed if you live near this place
Prohibited
You may park at the indicated place, because according to plate 8.2.3 «Zone of effect», sign 3.27 «No stopping» applies up to the sign.
Which of these signs oblige the driver of a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t to turn right?
Only А
Only Б
А and Б
Б and В

Of the signs shown, only the mandatory sign «Б» 4.1.2 «Turn right» applies to all vehicles and obliges everyone to turn right. Route vehicles – trams, trolleybuses, buses – may depart from it. Sign «А» 5.7.1 «Exit onto a one-way road» allows turning right and does not prohibit any vehicle from crossing this road or making a U-turn. Sign «В» 6.15.2 «Direction of movement for lorries» is a recommendation for lorries, tractors and self-propelled machines when their movement in one of the directions is prohibited at the intersection. (Road signs)
This marking shows:
Where a residential zone begins (ends)
A speed bump on the carriageway
Where a zone with parking restriction begins (ends)
Horizontal marking 1.25 marks a speed bump on the carriageway (the so-called «sleeping policeman»).
What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
It warns that the traffic light is faulty
It permits movement and informs that there is an unregulated intersection or pedestrian crossing
It prohibits further movement
A flashing yellow signal permits movement, informs that there is an unregulated intersection or pedestrian crossing, and warns road users of danger. (ПДД clause 6.2)
What mistake is the driver entering the courtyard making?
He turns within the zone of the sign «Straight ahead»
He turns without switching on the direction indicator
He makes both of the listed mistakes

Sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead», placed beyond an intersection of carriageways, does not prohibit turning right into courtyards and other adjacent territories. Before this manoeuvre the driver must switch on the corresponding indicator, i.e. inform other drivers of his intentions. Such mistakes are not rare. They are usually made by drivers who are used to being alone on quiet roads, or who were badly trained. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Must you give way to the lorry in this situation?
Yes
Yes, if it intends to turn right
No
When leaving the territory adjacent to the road, the lorry must give way to vehicles on the road. You have priority. (ПДД clause 8.3)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn?
Allowed
Allowed only along path А
Allowed only along path Б
Prohibited

U-turns are allowed at intersections marked with sign 5.7.2 «Exit onto a one-way road» (path «А»). A U-turn along path «Б» is not allowed, as U-turns are prohibited on pedestrian crossings. Here the limits of the pedestrian crossing are signs 5.19.1, 5.19.2 «Pedestrian crossing». (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.11)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue outside built-up areas in a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t?
60 km/h
70 km/h
90 km/h
Driving a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of less than 3.5 t, after sign 3.25 «End of maximum speed limit zone» you may continue at not more than 90 km/h. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.3)
Are you allowed to overtake?
Allowed
Allowed if the lorry's speed is less than 30 km/h
Prohibited

Sign 3.20 «No overtaking» prohibits overtaking all vehicles except slow-moving vehicles, horse-drawn carts, mopeds and two-wheeled motorcycles without a sidecar. Overtaking the lorry is prohibited. (Road signs)
Which of the drivers has broken the parking rules?
Both
Only the driver of car А
Only the driver of car Б
Nobody

The combination of sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» with plate 8.6.4 «Method of parking the vehicle» allows passenger cars to park here only as shown on the plate – at a right angle, with the front of the car towards the carriageway, as the driver of car «Б» did. The driver of car «А» breaks the parking rules, as his car faces the pavement. (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.2)
When turning left you:
Must give way to both vehicles
Must give way only to the passenger car
Have the right to go through the intersection first

The intersection is regulated. All three vehicles are allowed to move. Under equal conditions the tram has priority over trackless vehicles and goes first. When turning left, you must give way to the car coming straight towards you. The correct answer: you must give way to both vehicles. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 13.4, 13.6)
Who has the right to go through the intersection first if everyone intends to go straight ahead?
The trolleybus driver
You together with the trolleybus driver
In this situation the order is decided by mutual agreement of the drivers

The intersection is of equal roads. The lorry's yellow flashing beacon gives it no priority (ПДД clause 3.4). The «right-hand rule» cannot be applied, since everyone has an obstruction on the right. Indeed, the Rules do not explain this situation. The drivers should agree to let one vehicle through, and then the «right-hand rule» starts to work.
In which case must you give way to the pedestrians?
Only when turning left
Only when turning right
In both cases
At any intersection, when turning left or right, the driver must give way to pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road he is turning into. (ПДД clause 13.1)
In this situation you must stop:
By the traffic light or the barrier
Not closer than 5 m to the traffic light or the barrier
Not closer than 10 m to the nearest rail
Entering a level crossing when the barrier is closed is prohibited, whatever the traffic light shows. (ПДД clause 15.4)
At what distance from an oncoming vehicle should you switch from main beam to dipped headlights?
At least 150 m
At least 300 m
At the driver's discretion

When passing an oncoming vehicle you should switch from main beam to dipped headlights at least 150 m before it, and if the oncoming driver asks you to by flashing his headlights, switch even earlier. He will be grateful. Dazzle is physically unpleasant and dangerous, including for you. (ПДД clause 19.2)
In which case is the operation of a passenger car permitted?
There is visible damage, short circuits and traces of insulation breakdown on electrical wires
The coolant temperature gauge does not work
The state registration plate, its method and place of mounting do not meet the national standard
The identification signs that must be fitted on it are missing

Operating the vehicle is not prohibited if the coolant temperature gauge does not work (or is not fitted by design). In the other answers, according to clauses 9.6, 10.1 and 10.2 of the «List of faults», operation is prohibited.
What should a driver do to prevent a skid when going through a sharp bend?
Before the bend, reduce speed and press the clutch pedal so that the car coasts through the bend
Before the bend, reduce speed, shift to a lower gear if necessary, and in the bend do not sharply increase speed or brake
Any of the listed actions is allowed

To prevent a skid in a sharp bend, caused by centrifugal force, before entering the bend you must position the vehicle correctly on the carriageway so that your path through the bend has the largest possible radius, reduce speed (by about 1/3), shift to a lower gear if necessary, and in the bend not sharply increase speed or brake. (Russian driving school, Vehicle driving technique)
Is it allowed to give medicines to a casualty when giving first aid?
Allowed
Allowed in case of extreme necessity
Prohibited

The correct answer is: prohibited. Under current law, medicines may not be used when giving first aid, which is why they are not in the car first-aid kit. Also, a casualty who may be unconscious will have no swallowing reflex.
Which picture shows a road with a central reservation?
Both
Only the right one
Neither picture shows a road with a central reservation

A central reservation is a structurally separated element of the road – for example in the right picture – and/or one marked with solid marking lines 1.2 – for example in the left picture. The correct answer: both. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Central reservation»)
You are allowed to continue in a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t:
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead and right
In all directions

Plate 8.4.1 «Type of vehicle» under the sign makes sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead» apply to lorries, including those with a trailer, with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 t. Your vehicle is below that limit, so you may go through the intersection in all directions. (Road signs)
Which of these signs cancel all restrictions introduced earlier by prohibitory signs?
Only В
А and Б
В and Г
All of them
Sign «В» – 3.31 «End of zone of all restrictions». (Road signs)
This sign shows that:
You must turn right or left
The intersecting road has reversible traffic
Traffic is one-way to the right and to the left of the intersection
Ahead is an intersection where the intersecting road has reversible traffic, as shown by sign 5.10 «Exit onto a road with reversible traffic». (Road signs)
Which manoeuvre are you prohibited from making with this marking line?
Overtaking
Going around an obstacle
A U-turn
All the listed manoeuvres are allowed

Here the broken horizontal marking line 1.5 separates traffic flows. It may be crossed from either side. It prohibits none of the listed manoeuvres. On the contrary, it clearly shows you which side of the road you are on. (Horizontal road markings)
The signals of this traffic light apply:
Only to trams
To trams and to other vehicles moving in the lane for route vehicles
To all route vehicles
To control trams, and other route vehicles moving in a lane set aside for them, single-colour traffic lights with four round white-moon signals arranged in a «T» shape may be used. (ПДД clause 6.8)
Must you switch on the direction indicators in this situation?
Yes
Yes, only if there are other vehicles at the intersection
No
According to sign 4.1.2 «Turn right», you may continue only by turning right. Before turning you must give the corresponding warning signal. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Who must give way?
The passenger car driver
The lorry driver

Ahead the road narrows, as warned by sign 1.20.2 «Road narrows». The lorry driver must move into the left lane. He must give way to the passenger car travelling in the same direction without changing direction. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.4)
The driver has accidentally driven past the intersection. Is he allowed to reverse in order to then continue to the left?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct other road users
Prohibited
Reversing at intersections is prohibited. (ПДД clause 8.12)
Which cars, and in which cases, are allowed to drive outside built-up areas at not more than 90 km/h?
Passenger cars towing a trailer on motorways
Passenger cars and lorries with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t on all roads except motorways
All of the listed cars in the cases mentioned

Outside built-up areas, lorries with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t and passenger cars may drive at not more than 90 km/h on all roads except motorways, which are faster. A passenger car towing a trailer may drive on a motorway outside built-up areas at not more than 90 km/h. (ПДД clause 10.3)
May you overtake?
Yes
Yes, if the lorry's speed is less than 30 km/h
No

Overtaking is prohibited, since visibility is limited. Sometimes there is a natural wish to overtake a vehicle that is «crawling along». Do not give in to such urges thoughtlessly. Remember: overtaking is most dangerous when the vehicle being overtaken is much slower than the oncoming vehicle. (ПДД clause 11.4) The main condition for overtaking: «the distance needed to overtake must never exceed half of the visible stretch of road». So if you need 200 m to overtake, you must see at least 400 m of road. Stick strictly to this rule, or you will end up in a «trap» with no way out.
Is stopping allowed at this place?
Allowed
Allowed if the distance between the vehicle and the solid marking line is at least 3 m
Prohibited
Stopping on pedestrian crossings and closer than 5 m before them is prohibited. This distance is not respected. You may not stop at the indicated place. (ПДД clause 12.4)
The meaning of which road signs is cancelled by traffic light signals?
Priority signs
Prohibitory signs
Mandatory signs
All of the listed signs

Traffic is controlled by: a traffic controller, traffic light signals, priority signs, markings, the road surface, the «right-hand rule». According to this order of priority of traffic control means, priority signs apply (i.e. we follow them) when there is no traffic controller and the traffic light is switched off, faulty or in «flashing yellow» mode. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 6.15 and 13.3)
When turning right you must give way:
Only to the cyclist
Only to the pedestrians
To the pedestrians and the cyclist

When turning right or left, the driver must give way to pedestrians, users of personal mobility devices and cyclists crossing the carriageway of the road he is turning into. This rule applies at both regulated and unregulated intersections. (ПДД clause 13.1)
You intend to turn left. Whom must you give way to?
Nobody
Only the passenger car
The passenger car and the bus
All the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go, following the same rule. The passenger car goes first, you second, the motorcyclist third and the bus last. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
How should you act in this situation?
Drive over the level crossing without stopping before the sign
Stop before the sign and continue as soon as the train has passed
Stop before the sign and continue after making sure no train is approaching

There is a multi-track railway ahead. You must stop before sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping», wait for the train to pass and, after making sure no trains are approaching from either direction, continue. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 15.1, 15.2, 15.3, 15.4)
In a built-up area in daylight, you can attract the attention of the driver of the car you are overtaking:
Only with the horn
Only by briefly switching the headlights from dipped to main beam
Only with the horn and the light signal together
In any of the listed ways

Using the horn when overtaking is allowed only outside built-up areas. In a built-up area, instead of the horn, a light signal may be given to warn of overtaking: briefly switching the headlights from dipped to main beam. (ПДД clause 19.11)
In which case is the operation of the vehicle prohibited?
The fuel gauge does not work
The ignition timing is out of adjustment
The engine is hard to start
The horn is faulty
The «List of faults» prohibits operation if the horn does not work. («List of faults» clause 9.3)
How does a vehicle's braking distance depend on its speed?
It does not depend on it
It increases in proportion to the speed
It increases in proportion to the square of the speed

The braking distance depends on the square of the speed. So if the speed doubles, the braking distance becomes four times longer, and if the speed triples, nine times longer. (Vehicle driving technique)
How do you stop bleeding from a wounded vein or small arteries?
Apply a pressure bandage to the wound
Apply a tourniquet above the wound
Apply a tourniquet below the wound
A pressure bandage must be applied directly to the wound. (Medical assistance at road accidents)
Exiting a courtyard or another adjacent territory:
Is considered an intersection of equal roads
Is considered an intersection of unequal roads
Is not considered an intersection

«Adjacent territory» is an area directly next to the road and not intended for through traffic (courtyards, housing estates, car parks, filling stations, businesses, etc.). An exit from a courtyard or another adjacent territory is not considered an intersection. (ПДД clause 1.2)
Which of these signs require a mandatory stop?
Only А
Only Б
Б and В
All of them

Only sign «Б» 2.5 «No passing without stopping» requires a mandatory stop. It is placed either at an intersection of carriageways (case 1), or at a level crossing or a quarantine post (case 2). Sign «А» 2.6 «Priority of oncoming traffic» prohibits entering a narrow section of road if this could hinder oncoming traffic. Sign «В» 6.16 «Stop line» marks where vehicles stop when the traffic light shows a prohibiting signal at intersections or when crossing a level crossing is prohibited. Sign «Г» 2.4 «Give way» sets the order of passage at a particular intersection. If you need to stop, choose the place yourself, following the rule: «You must not start or continue moving or make any manoeuvre if your car's action would force other road users to change direction or speed». (Road signs)
In the zone of this sign, the horn may be used:
Only to warn of overtaking
Only to prevent a road traffic accident
In both of the listed cases
In the zone of sign 3.26 «No sound signals», using the horn is not allowed except to prevent a road traffic accident. (Road signs)
Where do the Rules for built-up areas start to apply?
Only from the sign «Beginning of built-up area» on a white background
From the sign with the name of the town on a white or blue background
At the beginning of the built-up land directly next to the road
Only from sign 5.23.1 or 5.23.2 «Beginning of built-up area» on a white background. (Road signs)
This vertical marking marks the sides of road barriers:
Only on dangerous sections of road
Only on sections of road that are not dangerous
On all sections of road
Vertical marking 2.6 marks the sides of road barriers in all cases where marking 2.5 is not used; marking 2.5 is used on bends, steep descents and other dangerous sections.
What does a flashing red signal, or two alternately flashing red signals, on a traffic light at a level crossing mean?
Movement is allowed with special caution
Movement is prohibited
The traffic light is faulty

A flashing red signal or two alternately flashing red signals prohibit movement. Flashing red signals are used at level crossings, before swing bridges, ferries or crossings, and where fire engines and other emergency vehicles come out. (ПДД clause 6.2, Commentary on the ПДД РФ, «За рулем» publishing house)
What light signals must you give in this situation?
Switch on the left direction indicators
Briefly switch the headlights from dipped to main beam
Give both of the listed light signals at the same time
You are moving into the left lane. Switching on the left indicator in good time is mandatory in any case. (ПДД clause 8.1)
In which directions may you continue from the second lane?
Only left
Left and in the opposite direction
Right, left and in the opposite direction

Sign 4.1.6 «Right or left» allows, from the leftmost lane, turning left and making a U-turn to drive in the opposite direction. To turn right you had to move into the rightmost lane in advance. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.5)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn at this place?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited
U-turns at stops for route vehicles are prohibited. (ПДД clause 8.11)
Along which path may you continue?
Only А
Only Б
Along either of them

Drivers turning onto a road marked with sign 5.10 «Exit onto a road with reversible traffic» must keep to the rightmost lane – here along path «Б». Changing lanes is allowed only after the driver has made sure that traffic in this direction is also allowed in the other lanes. (ПДД clause 9.8)
Is overtaking allowed at intersections?
Allowed
Allowed only at regulated intersections
Allowed only when driving on the priority road at unregulated intersections
Prohibited
Overtaking is prohibited at regulated intersections, and at unregulated intersections when driving on a road that is not the priority road. (ПДД clause 11.4)
The drivers of which cars have broken the stopping rules?
Only car Б
Cars Б and В
All the cars

When there is a shoulder, vehicles must stop and park on it (as the driver of car «А» did). Only if there is no shoulder, at the edge of the carriageway. The drivers of cars «Б» and «В» are breaking the ПДД. (ПДД clause 12.1)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Stop before the intersection, wait for the green light of the traffic light on the central reservation and start the manoeuvre
Enter the intersection, stop at the stop line and, after waiting for the green light of the traffic light on the central reservation, complete the manoeuvre
Make the manoeuvre without stopping at the intersection

Normally the driver leaves the intersection whatever the traffic lights at the exit show. But here it is different: the traffic lights work separately. The intersection has two intersections of carriageways. After turning left, if the traffic light shows a prohibiting signal, you must stop at the stop line (marking 1.12). When the permitting signal comes on, you continue through the intersection. (ПДД clause 13.7)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the passenger car
Only the lorry
Both vehicles

The intersection is of equal roads. Whatever its shape, drivers follow the «right-hand rule». The lorry goes first, as it has no obstruction on its right, the passenger car second, and you last. You must give way to both vehicles. (ПДД clause 13.11)
When going straight ahead you must give way:
Only to the passenger car
To the bus and the passenger car
To all the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go, following the «right-hand rule» between themselves: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. The motorcyclist has the obstruction on his right and gives way to you. The vehicles go through the intersection in this order: bus, passenger car, you, motorcyclist. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10)
Where must you stop if there is a traffic jam just beyond the pedestrian crossing?
On the pedestrian crossing if there are no pedestrians
Immediately before the pedestrian crossing
Not closer than 5 m before the pedestrian crossing

Here you are halting temporarily, not making a deliberate stop. So you stop before the boundary of the pedestrian crossing, which is marked by signs or markings. The correct answer: immediately before the pedestrian crossing. (ПДД clause 14.4)
Which picture shows a car whose driver is breaking the rules for carrying cargo?
Only А
Only Б
Both

The Rules allow vehicles up to 2.55 metres wide. Cargo sticking out at the side by not more than 0.4 m from the outer edge of the side light may be carried without the «Oversized load» identification sign. In picture «А» this distance is greater than allowed. In picture «Б» it is smaller. Only the driver of car «А» breaks the Rules. (ПДД clauses 23.4, 23.5)
In which case is the operation of vehicles prohibited?
The engine does not reach its maximum power
The engine runs unevenly at idle
The fuel supply and exhaust systems are incomplete and not airtight
If the engine's fuel supply and exhaust systems are faulty, incomplete or not airtight, operation of the vehicle is prohibited. («List of faults» clause 8.2)
The braking distance of a vehicle without an anti-lock braking system is reduced:
By pressing the brake pedal all the way
By pressing the brake pedal intermittently
By pressing the brake pedal and using the parking brake at the same time

Locked wheels when braking on a wet, slippery surface cause sliding – the car cannot be steered. So to shorten the braking distance and keep safe, press the brake pedal in pulses, intermittently, releasing it in between.
The minimum following distance when driving a passenger car on a dry road is taken to be the distance the car covers in at least:
1 second
2 seconds
3 seconds

Recommendations on this vary. The simplest one for car drivers is to keep a distance of at least half your speed (roughly the distance the car covers in 2 seconds). Keep in mind that in heavy traffic, with a longer distance other vehicles will often cut in front of you, which you will find stressful. The most important thing is to understand who the «leader» ahead of you is and how he behaves. What is your braking distance? There may be circumstances that make it longer than you are used to. The right actions will help you avoid a rear-end collision.

If a road traffic accident has caused damage only to property, then, after recording the position of the vehicles relative to each other and to road infrastructure objects, the traces and objects related to the accident and the damage to the vehicles, the driver involved in the accident:
Must clear the carriageway
Must clear the carriageway if it obstructs other vehicles
May clear the carriageway at his discretion

According to ПДД clause 2.6.1, if an accident has caused damage only to property, then after recording the position of the vehicles relative to each other and to road infrastructure objects, the traces and objects related to the accident and the damage to the vehicles, the driver involved must clear the carriageway if it obstructs other vehicles. (Question and answers updated on 14.12.18: the question is now about the conditions under which the driver may clear the carriageway.)
Which of these signs are used to mark the boundaries of a speed bump?
Only А
Only Б
Б and В
Sign «А» 5.20 «Speed bump» marks the boundary of a speed bump («sleeping policeman»). It is placed at the boundary of the speed bump nearest to approaching vehicles. (Road signs)
In this situation, stopping is:
Prohibited
Allowed only for route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis
Allowed only for vehicles driven by disabled people or carrying disabled people, including disabled children

Route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis may depart from sign 3.27 «No stopping», but only at stops for route vehicles or taxi ranks marked with marking 1.17.1 and/or signs 5.16, 5.18 respectively. This situation does not meet those requirements, so stopping in the zone of sign 3.27 is prohibited. (Road signs)
Driving which vehicle may you pass in this situation?
Only a passenger car
A passenger car or a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 2.5 t
A passenger car or a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t

Sign 5.15.7 «Lane directions» shows sign 3.4 «No lorries» without a figure on the lorry. In this case it prohibits lorries with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 t from using the left lane in your direction of travel. (Road signs)
What does this marking mean?
The road or route number
The recommended speed on this section of road
The maximum permitted speed on this section of road
Marking 1.24.2 duplicates sign 3.24 «Maximum speed limit» and is used together with it. (Horizontal road markings, Road signs)
What must road users follow if the traffic controller's instructions contradict the traffic lights and road signs?
The road signs
The traffic light signals
The traffic controller's instructions

The traffic controller's signals take precedence over traffic light signals and the requirements of road signs or markings (clause 6.15). When the controller sets an order of movement different from the existing traffic arrangement, he usually gives additional gestures or signals explaining the change. So you must follow the traffic controller's instructions, even if they contradict the traffic lights and road signs.
This hand signal, given by the motorcyclist in the left lane, informs you that he intends to:
Continue straight ahead
Turn right
Stop
Both hand signals show that the motorcyclists intend to turn right. (ПДД clause 8.1)
When moving into the right lane in this situation you:
Must give way to the car in the neighbouring lane
Have priority

The lane you are in is ending. You must change lanes. When changing lanes you must give way to vehicles travelling in the same direction without changing direction. (Horizontal road markings 1.19, ПДД clause 8.4)
Along which path are you allowed to make a U-turn?
Only А
Only Б
U-turns along the paths shown are prohibited

Sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead», placed before an intersection of carriageways, applies to the first intersection beyond the sign. This intersection has two intersections of carriageways, formed by the central reservation. Path «Б» goes through the first one, which contradicts the sign. You may make a U-turn along path «А». (Road signs)
What do you do in this situation?
Drive around the lorry on the right, on the shoulder
Continue only after the lorry has cleared the lane
Both courses of action are allowed

The lorry driver is signalling a turn. Passing on the right here is allowed only if you do it without driving onto the shoulder, which is prohibited. In this situation, wait until the lorry clears the lane. (ПДД clause 9.9)
Is overtaking on an uphill slope prohibited?
Prohibited
Prohibited only at the top of the hill
Allowed

The top of the hill is where the longitudinal profile of the road breaks. When approaching it you cannot see beyond. So the Rules prohibit overtaking at the top of a hill, on dangerous bends and on other sections with limited visibility. (ПДД clause 11.4) Do not forget the main condition for overtaking: «the distance needed to overtake must never exceed half of the visible stretch of road».
Are the drivers allowed to stop at the places shown?
Allowed
Allowed only for the motorcyclist
Prohibited
The distance between both stopped vehicles and the solid marking line is less than 3 m, which is not allowed. So stopping is prohibited. (ПДД clause 12.4)
How should you act when turning right?
Stop and wait for another signal from the traffic controller
Drive through the intersection, giving way to the tram
Go through the intersection first

The intersection is regulated. With this gesture, from the controller's left side, trackless vehicles may go in all directions. Trams move only «in the direction of the controller's arms». In this situation the tram cannot continue; its driver will wait for the controller's signal to change. You continue through the intersection, i.e. you go first. (ПДД clause 6.10)
How should you act when driving round the roundabout?
Give way to the lorry
Go through the intersection first
Act by mutual agreement with the lorry driver

When entering, from a road that is not the priority road, a roundabout marked with sign 4.3, the driver must give way to vehicles moving on it. (This is the third exceptional case where the «right-hand rule» does not apply.) In this situation you have priority and go through the intersection first. When entering the intersection, the lorry driver must give way to ALL vehicles moving on it. (ПДД clause 13.11.1)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the passenger car
The passenger car and the bus
All the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go, following the «right-hand rule» between themselves: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. The motorcyclist has the obstruction on his right and gives way to you. The vehicles go through the intersection in this order: bus, passenger car, you, motorcyclist. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10)
What is the minimum distance from the nearest rail at which you must stop?
5 m
When there is no barrier, the driver must stop not closer than 10 m from the nearest rail. (ПДД clause 15.4)
When towing with a flexible tow, the distance between the towing and the towed vehicle must be:
Not more than 4 m
From 4 to 6 m
From 6 to 8 m
When towing with a flexible tow, the distance between the towing and the towed vehicle must be 4–6 m. (ПДД clause 20.3)
Which administrative offences committed by a driver who is disqualified from driving entail administrative arrest?
Driving a vehicle; leaving, in breach of the Rules, the scene of a road traffic accident in which he was involved
Driving a vehicle while intoxicated; refusing a lawful demand of an authorised official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication
All of the listed actions
Administrative arrest of drivers for all the listed actions is provided by the КоАП: art. 12.7 part 2; art. 12.26 part 2; art. 12.27 part 2.
Correcting a rear-axle skid by increasing speed is possible:
Only in a front-wheel-drive car
Only in a rear-wheel-drive car
In any of the listed cars

A front-wheel-drive car differs not only in layout but also in how it behaves on the road. On a straight road it has no tendency at all to skid. Skids happen in bends, because of centrifugal force. While the driver of a rear-wheel-drive car slows down and steers into the skid in this situation, the driver of a front-wheel-drive car must never do so. Easing off the accelerator causes engine braking, and inertia makes the car «dip» forward, which unloads the rear wheels – but to regain grip, the rear wheels need extra load, which comes from increasing speed.
Which picture shows the correct position of the hands on the steering wheel?
The left one
The middle one
The right one
The best position of the hands on the wheel, compared with a clock face, is «ten to two». The correct answer: the right picture. (Vehicle driving technique)
Must a driver provide his vehicle to medical and pharmaceutical workers to take citizens to the nearest medical institution in life-threatening cases?
Yes
Yes, only when travelling in the same direction
No
ПДД clause 2.3.3 obliges drivers to provide this transport service to medical and pharmaceutical workers.
You may continue:
Only along path А
Only along path Б
Along either of the paths shown

The central reservations divide the road into adjoining carriageways. Sign 4.1.2 «Turn right», placed before an intersection of carriageways, applies to the first intersection. You may continue only along path «А». (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Central reservation», Road signs)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue in a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t?
60 km/h
70 km/h
80 km/h

Plate 8.4.3 «Type of vehicle» makes the sign apply to passenger cars and to lorries with a permitted maximum weight of up to 3.5 t. You may continue at a maximum of 80 km/h, as your vehicle is of exactly this type. (Road signs)
Which of these signs are used to show the number assigned to a road (route)?
Only А
Only Б
А and Б
All of them
Signs «А» and «Б» share the same number and name: 6.14.1 «Route number». Sign «В» 6.13 «Kilometre sign» shows the distance to the beginning or end of the road (km). (Road signs)
Driving in the cycle lane of the carriageway marked with this marking is allowed:
Only for users of personal mobility devices and mopeds
Only for mopeds and motorcycles with an internal combustion engine of not more than 125 cm³ and a maximum power of not more than 11 kW
For users of personal mobility devices, mopeds and motorcycles
In a lane of the carriageway marked with marking 1.23.3, besides cyclists, mopeds and users of personal mobility devices are allowed. (Horizontal road markings, ПДД clause 24.2)
You have the right to go:
Only straight ahead
Only right
Straight ahead or right

The intersection is regulated. From the traffic controller's left and right sides, trackless vehicles may go straight ahead or right. On the intersecting road, according to sign 5.7.1 «Exit onto a one-way road», traffic is one-way. This sign prohibits only turning left. (Road signs, ПДД clause 6.10)
How must you mark your vehicle after a road traffic accident?
Only with the hazard warning lights
Only with the warning triangle
In both of the listed ways
After an accident, the driver must switch on the hazard warning lights and set out the warning triangle. (ПДД clauses 7.1, 7.2)
Who has priority?
The passenger car driver
The lorry driver

The passenger car driver is joining the road from an adjacent territory (a filling station). He must give way to vehicles on the road he is entering, so the lorry driver has «priority». (ПДД clauses 1.2, 8.3)
Is the driver allowed to reverse on this section of road to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed if the driver is driving a passenger taxi
Prohibited
Sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead» does not prohibit reversing outside the limits of the intersection. On this section you may reverse to the passenger, under that condition. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.12)
Driving a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of more than 2.5 t, may you move into the third lane in this situation?
Allowed
Allowed only to turn left or make a U-turn
Allowed only to pass
Prohibited

The driver of a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of more than 2.5 t may move into the leftmost lane, when there are three or more lanes in his direction, only to turn left or make a U-turn. (ПДД clause 9.4)
Driving a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t, may you overtake the tractor?
Yes
Yes, if the tractor's speed is less than 30 km/h
No
Sign 3.22 «No overtaking for lorries» does not apply to lorries with a permitted maximum weight of up to 3.5 t. If you are driving such a vehicle, you may overtake. (Road signs)
At which place and in which direction are you allowed to stop?
Only В
Б and В
At any of the places shown

On a road with one lane in each direction and no tram tracks in the middle, in a built-up area marked with sign 5.23.1 or 5.23.2 «Beginning of built-up area» (on a white background), stopping and parking are allowed not only on the right side but also on the left side of the road. So you may stop at any of the places shown. (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.1)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the car
Only the tram
The car and the tram
Nobody

The intersection is regulated. Under equal conditions the tram has priority over trackless vehicles. At the same time, since their paths do not cross, the passenger car turning right will go; you must also give way to it when turning left. You go through the intersection last. (ПДД clauses 13.3, 13.4, 13.6)
You must give way to the lorry:
Only when going straight ahead
Only when turning right
In both of the listed cases

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule». You will have an obstruction on your right only when going straight ahead – you give way to the lorry. When turning right there is no obstruction on your right. (ПДД clause 13.11)
You intend to make a U-turn. Whom must you give way to?
Only the lorry
Only the passenger car
Both vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority over the others, whatever direction they are going in. Between themselves they follow the «right-hand rule». The lorry goes first, you after it, and the passenger car last. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Where are you allowed to stop when driving on a motorway?
Only in 500 m
Anywhere to the right of the line marking the edge of the carriageway
Anywhere at the edge of the carriageway

On a motorway, stopping is prohibited outside special parking areas marked with signs 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» or 7.11 «Rest area» (shown in the picture). Here the place is 500 m away. (Road signs, ПДД clause 16.1)
Driving at night outside a built-up area with main-beam headlights on, you have caught up with a vehicle ahead. What do you do?
Keep the side lights on and switch off the main-beam headlights
Switch from main beam to dipped headlights
Both courses of action are allowed
To avoid dazzling the driver ahead through his rear-view mirrors, you must switch from main beam to dipped headlights. (ПДД clause 19.2)
What must the driver do if the windscreen washer fails while driving?
Continue the planned journey with special caution
Try to fix the fault on the spot, and if this is impossible, proceed to the place of parking or repair taking the necessary precautions
Stop driving

Clause 3 of the «Basic Provisions» prohibits operating a vehicle with faults affecting road safety. ПДД clause 2.3.1 does not prohibit continuing with such a fault to the place of parking or repair, taking precautions.
What should you do if the rear axle of a rear-wheel-drive car starts to skid in a bend?
Increase the fuel supply and stabilise the movement with the steering wheel
Brake slightly and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid
Greatly reduce the fuel supply without changing the steering wheel position
Slightly reduce the fuel supply and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid

Do not panic in this situation. Do not suddenly take your foot off the accelerator. Reduce the engine speed as smoothly as possible, and to correct the skid, turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
In which case must the driver assess the situation behind?
Before moving off or resuming movement
Before braking
Before a manoeuvre (changing lanes or changing direction)
In all of the listed cases

Before any manoeuvre you should assess the situation behind, including in the listed cases. This is usually done using the rear-view mirrors. Keep in mind that they have «blind» spots. So it is better to avoid sudden manoeuvres.
What does the requirement to give way mean?
You must stop only if there is a «Give way» sign
You must always stop to let other road users pass
