You must not start, resume or continue moving, or make any manoeuvre, if this may force other road users who have priority over you to change direction or speed
If you do not meet the requirement to give way, you are not just breaking the Rules – you are creating an emergency situation. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Give way»)
Which of these signs give the right of way at unregulated intersections?
Only А
А and В
All of them

Signs 2.1 «Priority road» («А») and 2.3.5 «Secondary road joining» («В») give the right of way at unregulated intersections to vehicles on the priority road. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Priority road», 13.9)
Are you allowed to overtake?
Allowed
Allowed if the motorcycle's speed is not more than 30 km/h
Prohibited

Remember that sign 3.20 «No overtaking» prohibits overtaking all vehicles except slow-moving vehicles, horse-drawn carts, mopeds and two-wheeled motorcycles without a sidecar. You may overtake, whatever the motorcyclist's speed. (Road signs)
May the driver park the lorry at this place in the way shown?
Yes
Yes, if the lorry's permitted maximum weight is not more than 3.5 t
No

Where sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» is placed with one of plates 8.6.2, 8.6.3 and 8.6.6–8.6.9 «Method of parking the vehicle», lorries may not park within the zone of this sign. ПДД clause 12.2 also does not allow any lorry to park at the edge of the pavement in other places not marked with signs. So the answer is clear: the lorry driver is breaking the Rules. (Road signs)
This vertical marking is used to mark:
Only the lower edge of the span of tunnels, bridges and overpasses
Only the entrance to unlit tunnels
Any elements of road structures that are a danger
Vertical marking 2.2 marks the lower edge of the span of tunnels, bridges and overpasses. (Vertical road markings)
Where must you stop?
Before the traffic light
Before the stop line
At any of the listed places
When there is a stop line (marking 1.12) and the traffic light shows a prohibiting signal, you must stop before the stop line. (Horizontal road markings, ПДД clause 6.13)
Must drivers signal with the direction indicators when manoeuvring in a car park or at a filling station?
Yes
Yes, only if there are other vehicles nearby
No

Always inform other road users of your intentions, whatever the place, conditions or circumstances in which you are driving. Before manoeuvring, switch on the corresponding direction indicator. (ПДД clause 8.1)
Which of the drivers is breaking the turning rules at the intersection?
Both
Only the motorcyclist turning left
Only the car driver
Nobody

Both drivers break the manoeuvring rules when turning. Before turning, the motorcyclist should have taken the corresponding outermost position on the carriageway. When turning right, the car driver must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway; he can do so, so he should have turned into the rightmost lane. (ПДД clauses 8.5, 8.6)
Is the driver allowed to reverse when there are no other road users?
Allowed
Allowed only up to the pedestrian crossing
Prohibited

Reversing on sections of road marked with sign 5.5 «One-way road» is not prohibited. So you may do this manoeuvre up to the pedestrian crossing, since reversing on pedestrian crossings is prohibited. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.12)
May you move into the leftmost lane in this situation?
Yes
Yes, if the horse-drawn cart is moving at not more than 30 km/h
No
On a two-way road with three lanes, moving into the leftmost lane, which is intended for oncoming traffic, is prohibited. (ПДД clause 9.3)
Are you allowed to overtake?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct other road users
Prohibited
The intersection is of equal roads. Overtaking is prohibited at intersections of equal roads. (ПДД clause 11.4)
Which of the drivers has broken the stopping rules?
Both
Only the driver of car А
Only the driver of car Б
Nobody

Do not confuse stopping with parking. Stopping is prohibited on the level crossing itself, whose limits are the barriers. Parking is prohibited on the level crossing itself and closer than 50 m from it. The drivers stopped outside the level crossing without breaking the rules. (ПДД clauses 12.4, 12.1)
When making which manoeuvre does the passenger car driver have priority?
Only when turning left
Only when making a U-turn
When making any of the listed manoeuvres

The passenger car driver, moving on the green arrow of an additional section switched on together with the main green signal, may turn left and make a U-turn. The bus and the lorry, moving on the green arrow of an additional section switched on together with the main red signal, must give way to all other vehicles from all other directions. In this situation the passenger car driver has priority for any of the listed manoeuvres. (ПДД clause 13.5)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Give way to the tram and turn from the left lane
Let the tram pass, move onto the tram tracks in the same direction, then turn
Go through the intersection first
You and the tram are under equal conditions. In that case the tram has priority over trackless vehicles. You give way to the tram. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when going straight ahead?
Only the passenger car
Only the bus
Both vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. Between themselves they follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You are on the secondary road, so you give way to both vehicles. (Road signs 2.4, 8.13, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10)
Driving a lorry, may you pass in this situation?
Yes
Yes, if the lorry's permitted maximum weight is not more than 2.5 t
No

On any road with three or more lanes in one direction, you may use the leftmost lane only in heavy traffic when the other lanes are occupied, or to turn left or make a U-turn; lorries with a permitted maximum weight of more than 2.5 t only to turn left or make a U-turn. You may pass if the lorry's permitted maximum weight is not more than 2.5 t. (ПДД clause 9.4)
When driving in daylight, the vehicle must have switched on:
Only the daytime running lights
Only the dipped headlights
Only the fog lights
Any of the listed external lights

In daylight, all moving vehicles except bicycles must have dipped headlights or daytime running lights switched on, to make them visible. Fog lights may be used instead of dipped headlights for this purpose. (ПДД clauses 19.4, 19.5)
The operation of a passenger car (category M1) is prohibited if the remaining tyre tread depth (without wear indicators) is not more than:
0.8 mm
1.0 mm
1.6 mm
2.0 mm
Operating passenger cars (including category M1) with tyres (without a wear indicator) whose remaining tread depth is 1.6 mm or less is prohibited. («List of faults» clause 5.4)
What should you do to quickly restore the effectiveness of the vehicle's brakes after driving through water?
Press the brake pedal sharply, then continue
Continue and dry the brake pads with repeated short presses on the brake pedal
Continue at low speed without braking

Some drivers do not take this seriously, which leads to hitting obstacles, etc., because «wet brakes» are much less effective, especially drum brakes. Dry the brakes with short presses, after first shifting to a lower gear.
What are the first actions when giving first aid for a wound received in a road accident?
Rinse the wound with water, remove foreign bodies embedded in it, apply sterile cotton wool and secure it with a bandage
Put on medical gloves, rinse the wound with an alcohol iodine solution, apply a healing ointment and cover it completely with adhesive plaster
Put on medical gloves, do not rinse the wound, put a sterile gauze pad on it and secure it with adhesive plaster at the edges or with a bandage

To avoid infections transmitted through the casualty's blood, when giving first aid you must first put on medical gloves; do not rinse the wound; put a sterile gauze pad on it and secure it with adhesive plaster at the edges or with a bandage. Do not cover the wound completely with plaster (seal it), as this leads to complications.
Which picture shows an intersection?
Only the left one
Only the right one
Both

An intersection is a place where roads cross, join or branch at the same level. The left picture shows an intersection of unequal roads. Exits from adjacent territories are not considered intersections – for example the right picture. (ПДД clause 1.2)
You may make a U-turn:
Only along path А
Only along path Б
Along either of the paths shown
When sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead» is placed before an intersection of carriageways, it applies only to the first intersection beyond the sign. You may make a U-turn along path «Б». (Road signs)
Are you allowed to park the car at this place on odd dates of the month?
Allowed
Allowed only after 9 pm
Prohibited

This is in a built-up area, on a road with one lane in each direction and no tram tracks in the middle. On such a road you may stop and park not only on the right side but also on the left, if there are no prohibiting signs. Here both signs are used: on the right, 3.29 «No parking on odd dates of the month», on the left, 3.30 «No parking on even dates of the month». When parking in this case, remember that from 21:00 to 24:00 these signs do not apply, to allow cars to be moved. So at the intended place the car may be parked from 21:00 on an odd date until 24:00 on the following even date. Allowed only after 9 pm. (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.1)
Which of these signs mark sections where the driver must give way to pedestrians on the carriageway?
Only Б
Б and В
All of them

Signs «Б» 5.19.2 «Pedestrian crossing» and «В» 5.21 «Residential zone» give pedestrians priority on the carriageway on the sections and areas they mark. Warning sign «А» 1.22 «Pedestrian crossing» warns of the approach to a pedestrian crossing marked with signs 5.19.1, 5.19.2 and/or markings 1.14.1 and 1.14.2; it is placed 50–100 m before it in built-up areas and 150–300 m outside them. (Road signs)
What does the marking А100 on the carriageway mean?
The distance to the nearest intersection
The distance to the nearest town
The road number
This horizontal marking 1.22 shows the road number.
You may continue:
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead or right
Only right

Here the traffic controller uses the basic signal – arms lowered («chest or back – a wall»). From his right and left sides, trackless vehicles may go straight ahead and right. According to marking 1.18, which sets lane directions, you could only turn right. But in the official answer table the correct answer is no. 2, «Straight ahead or right», based on the paragraph of ПДД clause 6.15: «Drivers and pedestrians must obey the signals and instructions of the traffic controller, even if they contradict traffic light signals, road signs or markings». In practice, traffic controllers (including ГИБДД officers) should apply this paragraph not in a normal situation but only when necessary – after an accident, in a jam, to let convoys or special vehicles through, etc. But we are preparing for the ГИБДД exam, so with these reservations we accept this answer, based on ПДД clause 6.15.
How should you act when turning left on a two-lane road?
Start the manoeuvre while switching on the left indicator
Switch on the left indicator, then start the manoeuvre
Make sure the manoeuvre is safe, then switch on the left indicator and start the manoeuvre

On any road, when turning left or making a U-turn, you switch on the left indicator in good time, as ПДД clause 8.1 requires. But since here there is one lane in each direction, a driver behind you in the same direction may already have signalled and started to overtake you. Then, under ПДД clause 11.3, your actions would obstruct him and you would unknowingly be breaking the ПДД. So on such a road, in traffic, smoothly reduce speed in advance with almost no braking, lightly pressing the brake pedal a few times to show the brake lights; meanwhile make sure nobody is overtaking, switch on the left indicator and, after checking again that other drivers have understood that you intend to turn left or make a U-turn, start the manoeuvre, taking oncoming traffic into account. (ПДД clauses 8.1, 11.1)
You intend to move off from the pavement. Must you give way to the motorcycle making a U-turn?
Yes
No, if you are driving a passenger taxi
No

Before moving off, the driver must make sure the manoeuvre is safe and will not obstruct other road users (ПДД clause 8.1). According to this clause, you give way to the motorcyclist, whatever vehicle you are driving.
Is the passenger car driver allowed to reverse in the tunnel to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct other road users
Prohibited
Reversing in tunnels is prohibited. Also, whatever the lighting in the tunnel, the vehicle's lights must be switched on. This driver's actions must be considered dangerous. (ПДД clauses 8.11, 8.12)
In this situation you may drive:
Only in the right lane
In the right or middle lane
In any lane

On any road with three or more lanes in one direction, you may use the leftmost lane only in heavy traffic when the other lanes are occupied. You are driving alone. You may continue in the lane you are in, or move into the rightmost lane. (ПДД clause 9.4)
Is overtaking allowed in a tunnel?
Allowed
Allowed only if there is artificial lighting
Prohibited
Overtaking is prohibited on and under bridges, overpasses and flyovers, and in tunnels. (ПДД clause 11.4)
May the driver park the car in the way shown?
Yes
Yes, if this does not obstruct other vehicles
No

Parking at an angle to the edge of the carriageway is prohibited, except in places whose shape allows a different arrangement (a local widening of the carriageway), marked with the corresponding signs and markings. (ПДД clause 12.2)
In which case must you give way to the lorry?
When turning left
When making a U-turn
In both of the listed cases

The intersection is regulated. You are allowed to go. When turning left or making a U-turn, you must give way to vehicles coming straight ahead or turning right from the opposite direction. You give way to the lorry in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clauses 13.3, 13.4)
You intend to continue straight ahead on a flashing yellow light. What do you do?
Stop and continue only after the green light comes on
Give way to the horse-drawn cart
Go through the intersection first together with the oncoming car

With a flashing yellow light the intersection is unregulated – here of equal roads, since there are no priority signs. We follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You have an obstruction on your right, so you go through the intersection last, giving way to the horse-drawn cart. (ПДД clauses 13.3, 13.11)
You intend to turn left. Whom must you give way to?
The passenger car and the bus
Only the bus
Only the motorcycle
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go, following the same rule. You go first, giving way to nobody. The motorcyclist goes second, the bus third, and the passenger car last. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.1, 13.11)
In which case must the driver of a vehicle approaching an unregulated pedestrian crossing give way to pedestrians?
If the pedestrians are crossing the road
If the pedestrians have stepped onto the carriageway (tram tracks) to cross
In both of the listed cases
The driver of a vehicle approaching an unregulated pedestrian crossing must meet the «give way» requirement. This must be done in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 14.1)
Must you switch from main beam to dipped headlights if the oncoming driver shows the need for it by repeatedly switching his headlights?
Yes
Yes, only if the distance to the oncoming vehicle is less than 150 m
No
Repeatedly switching the headlights is the oncoming driver's way of asking you to switch your lights to avoid dazzling him. (ПДД clause 19.2, Vehicle driving technique)
What administrative penalty may be imposed on a driver for leaving, in breach of the Rules, the scene of a road traffic accident in which he is involved?
Only a fine of 1,000 to 1,500 roubles
A fine of 1,000 to 1,500 roubles or disqualification from driving for 1 to 1.5 years
Disqualification from driving for 1 to 1.5 years or administrative arrest for up to 15 days

According to Article 12.27 part 2, a driver who leaves, in breach of the Rules, the scene of an accident in which he is involved is punished by disqualification from driving for 1 to 1.5 years or administrative arrest for up to 15 days. (Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation)
To prevent a car with a manual gearbox from rolling back during a short stop on an uphill slope, you should:
Apply the parking brake
Engage first gear or reverse
Put the gear lever in neutral
During a short stop on an uphill slope, in a car with a manual gearbox you should apply the parking brake.
Does the choice of lateral clearance depend on speed?
The lateral clearance does not depend on speed
As speed increases, the lateral clearance must be increased
As speed increases, the lateral clearance may be reduced

Every vehicle by design has a «dynamic corridor», i.e. its sideways deviation from a straight line. Long vehicles and vehicle combinations have an especially wide «corridor». As speed increases, the lateral clearance from vehicles going in the same and in the opposite direction must be increased.
A driving licence for category «A» vehicles also confirms the right to drive:
Subcategory «A1» vehicles
Subcategory «B1» vehicles with motorcycle-type seating or handlebars
Category «M» vehicles
All of the listed vehicles
According to Article 26 clause 2.2 of the Federal Law «On Road Traffic Safety», a driving licence for category «A» vehicles also confirms the right to drive all of the listed vehicles.
Which of these signs inform you of the approach to the start of a section of road with oncoming traffic?
Only А
А and Б
All of them

Only warning sign «А» 1.21 «Two-way traffic» is placed before a carriageway with oncoming traffic when a one-way section came before it. Sign «Б» 5.8 «Reversible traffic» informs of the start of a section where the direction of traffic in one or more lanes may be reversed. Sign «В» 5.15.7 «Lane directions» shows how traffic in both directions is arranged on a three-lane road. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to drive to your place of work located within the zone of these signs?
Allowed
Allowed only on working days
Allowed only on days off
Prohibited

Plate 8.5.2 «Working days» shows that sign 3.2 «No vehicles» applies only on working days. But since people who live, work or serve businesses within the sign's zone may depart from it, you may drive past the sign on any day of the week. (Road signs)
What does this road sign with a yellow background inform you about?
You can continue only in the second lane
You can continue only on the carriageway for the opposite direction
You can continue only on another road

Sign 6.19.1 «Advance sign for changing to another carriageway» shows how to get around a section of carriageway closed to traffic on a road with a central reservation. The yellow background means the diversion is temporary. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to cross the double solid horizontal marking line?
Allowed only when leaving courtyards and other adjacent territories
Allowed only when overtaking
Allowed only in heavy traffic
Prohibited
Crossing the double solid horizontal marking 1.3, which separates traffic flows in opposite directions, is PROHIBITED in all cases. (Horizontal road markings)
What do the arrows on the green traffic light inform you about?
Turning right is always prohibited at this intersection
Right turns are controlled by an additional section
At this intersection, turning left is allowed from two lanes

Black outline arrows on the main green signal inform drivers that there is an additional section and show the permitted directions other than the one controlled by the additional section. (ПДД clause 6.4)
This hand signal given by the passenger car driver informs you:
That he intends to move off
That he is asking for help
That there is a danger round the bend
The left arm extended to the side is a left-turn signal, which the driver must give before moving off. (ПДД clause 8.1)
In which direction is the passenger car driver allowed to continue?
Only round the circle
Only right
In any of the listed directions

As an exception, you may enter a roundabout from any lane of your direction (without changing lanes beforehand). Leaving it follows the general rules. To turn right you must take the corresponding outermost position on the carriageway in good time. When turning, the vehicle must also keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway. The lorry's path follows these rules. The passenger car driver may only continue round the circle. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 8.5, 8.6)
At the intersection you may continue:
Only left
Left and in the opposite direction
In any direction
U-turns are not prohibited at intersections. In this situation you may continue in any direction. (ПДД clause 8.11)
Driving in a built-up area at more than 60 km/h is allowed:
Only when overtaking
Only if road signs allowing more than 60 km/h are placed
In both of the listed cases
In built-up areas the speed is limited to not more than 60 km/h. A higher speed may be allowed on some sections of road by placing signs 3.24 «Maximum speed limit». (ПДД clause 10.2)
In this situation, priority belongs to:
The passenger car, as it is going uphill
The lorry, as it is going downhill
The lorry, as the obstacle is in the passenger car's lane

When passing oncoming vehicles is difficult on gradients marked with signs 1.13 «Steep descent» or 1.14 «Steep ascent», the driver of the vehicle going downhill must give way. Here the lorry driver gives way. The passenger car driver has priority, as he is going uphill. (ПДД clause 11.7)
May you park the car at the indicated place?
Yes
Yes, only if visibility of the road is at least 100 m
No
When you can pull off onto the shoulder, you may park even where visibility is limited. (ПДД clauses 12.1, 12.4, 12.5)
How should you act when turning left?
Stop at the stop line and wait for the traffic controller's signal allowing the turn
Enter the intersection, stop and wait for the traffic controller's signal allowing the turn
Turn, giving way to the oncoming car

The intersection is regulated. The traffic controller's arms are lowered. From his right and left sides, trackless vehicles may go straight ahead and right. But you intend to turn left. So you must stop before the stop line and wait for the controller's signal that matches your intention, then make the manoeuvre. (ПДД clauses 6.10, 6.13, 13.3, Horizontal road markings 1.12)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What do you do?
Go through the intersection together with the tram, without giving way to the lorry
Go through the intersection, giving way to the lorry

The intersection is of equal roads. At such intersections the tram has priority over trackless vehicles, whatever direction it is going in. Trackless vehicles follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You have an obstruction on your right – you give way to the lorry. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when going straight ahead?
Only the motorcycle
The motorcycle and the passenger car
The bus and the motorcycle
All the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go through, following the same rule. The motorcyclist goes first, the bus second, the passenger car third. You go last, giving way to all vehicles. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Is driving instruction allowed on this road?
Prohibited
Allowed only in the rightmost lane of the carriageway
Allowed
According to sign 5.1, this is a motorway. Learner driving on it is not prohibited, i.e. it is allowed. (ПДД clause 16.1)
May fog lights be used instead of dipped headlights in daylight?
Yes
Yes, except in tunnels and in conditions of insufficient visibility
No
This is allowed in daylight, except when driving in tunnels and in conditions of insufficient visibility. (ПДД clauses 19.4, 19.5)
Is it allowed to fit tyres with different tread patterns on one axle of a passenger car?
Allowed
Allowed only on the rear axle
Prohibited

Tyres with different tread patterns behave differently, because their grip on the road is uneven. This difference can make the car skid both in bends and when braking. («Basic Provisions», «List of faults» clause 5.8)
If the tyres lose grip on the road because of a «water wedge» (aquaplaning), the driver should:
Increase speed
Reduce speed by pressing the brake pedal sharply
Reduce speed using engine braking

Aquaplaning occurs when driving a passenger car in heavy rain or through standing water in dips on the road – in autumn, spring or during a thaw. Knowing about it, the driver should not be taken by surprise. There is only one piece of advice: immediately reduce speed using engine braking. (Vehicle driving technique)
How does a driver's fatigue affect his attention and reaction?
Attention weakens, reaction time decreases
Attention weakens, reaction time increases
Attention and reaction time do not change

Tiredness and fatigue clearly affect road safety. Attention weakens and reaction time increases. A good driver should take breaks that from time to time interrupt the monotony of driving. A few minutes are often enough to restore the level of attention needed to drive safely. («Driving school», A. I. Kopusov-Dolinin, «ЭКСМО» publishing house)
At whose demand must drivers undergo an examination for alcohol intoxication and a medical examination for intoxication?
Any traffic controller
Officials authorised to carry out federal state control (supervision) of road safety
Any police officer

The driver must undergo an examination for alcohol intoxication and a medical examination for intoxication at the demand of officials who have the right of state supervision and control over road safety and vehicle operation. (ПДД clause 2.3.2)
Which of these signs inform you that at the intersection you must give way to vehicles approaching from the left?
Only А
Only Б
А and Б
All of them

The order of passage at intersections is set by priority signs, here «А» and «Б». Sign «А» 2.3.3 «Secondary road joining» informs that the road joining from the left is secondary; driving on the priority road, you have priority. The combination «Б» – 2.4 «Give way» with plate 8.13 «Direction of the priority road» – informs that vehicles on the priority road on the left and straight ahead from the opposite direction have priority; you must give way to them. Sign «В» 5.13.1 «Exit onto a road with a lane for route vehicles» belongs to the special regulation signs; it cannot set the order of passage. (Road signs)
Driving a passenger car with a trailer, may you continue straight ahead?
Allowed
Allowed if you live in the zone marked by the sign
Prohibited
Sign 3.7 «No vehicles with trailers» prohibits only lorries and tractors with trailers. It does not apply to passenger cars with trailers. (Road signs)
You are allowed to go:
Only in direction Б
In directions А and Б
In directions Б and В
In any of the directions shown

Sign 5.7.2 «Exit onto a one-way road» prohibits turning right, i.e. driving against the traffic. The permitted directions at such an intersection are straight ahead, left (in the direction of the arrow on the sign) and U-turn. You may continue in any of the directions shown. (Road signs)
What does the lengthening of the dashes of a broken marking line inform you about?
The start of a zone where all manoeuvres are prohibited
The start of a dangerous section of road
The approach to a solid marking line separating traffic flows in the same direction

Marking 1.6 (warning line – a broken line whose dashes are three times longer than the gaps) warns of the approach to solid line 1.1 (or 1.11), which separates traffic flows – here in the same direction. (Horizontal road markings)
May you move into the neighbouring lane?
Yes
Yes, if the lorry is moving at 30 km/h
No

To make this manoeuvre you would have to move into the reversible-traffic lane. The red signal of the reversible traffic light prohibits driving in this lane. (ПДД clause 6.7, Horizontal road markings)
Must you switch on the right direction indicator before entering this intersection?
Yes
Yes, only if there are vehicles moving behind
No
When entering a roundabout you turn right. You must inform other road users of this by switching on the right indicator. (ПДД clause 8.1)
When leaving an adjacent territory you must give way:
Only to route vehicles
To all motor vehicles
To vehicles, users of personal mobility devices and pedestrians
When entering a road from an adjacent territory, the driver must give way to vehicles, users of personal mobility devices and pedestrians. (ПДД clause 8.3)
Is a U-turn allowed on a section of road marked with this sign?
Allowed
Allowed only in a built-up area
Allowed only if visibility of the road is at least 100 m
Prohibited
By making a U-turn on a road marked with sign 5.5 «One-way road», you would drive against the traffic, which is not allowed on such a road. (Road signs)
In which cases is the driver prohibited from driving faster than 50 km/h?
When riding a moped
When towing a motor vehicle
If such a ban is set by the road sign «Maximum speed limit»
In all of the listed cases
In all of the listed cases the driver is prohibited from driving faster than 50 km/h. (ПДД clauses 1.2, term «Moped», 10.4, sign 3.24 «Maximum speed limit»)
Is overtaking allowed on a pedestrian crossing?
Allowed
Prohibited only if there are pedestrians on it
Prohibited
Overtaking on pedestrian crossings is prohibited. (ПДД clause 11.4)
At which place may you stop?
Only В
А and В
Б and В
At any of the places shown

Outside built-up areas, stopping and parking are allowed only on the right side of the road – on the shoulder, or if there is none, at the edge of the carriageway. You act correctly if you stop at place «В». (ПДД clause 12.1)
How should you act when turning left?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the lorry with the flashing beacon switched on
Give way only to the bus

The intersection is regulated. The priority signs «do not apply». The lorry with the «yellow flashing light» is standing and waiting for the traffic light to let it go, because a yellow special signal does not allow it to depart from traffic light signals. When turning left you must give way to vehicles going straight ahead from the opposite direction. You give way to the bus. (ПДД clauses 3.4, 13.3, 13.4)
You intend to make a U-turn. What do you do?
Make the U-turn first
Enter the intersection and, after giving way to the passenger car, complete the U-turn
Act by mutual agreement with the passenger car driver

The intersection is of equal roads. To decide the order of passage, drivers follow the «right-hand rule». During the U-turn you will have an obstruction on your right, so you give way. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when going straight ahead?
Only the tram
Only the passenger car
The tram and the passenger car
All the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority, and trackless vehicles follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves, giving way to the tram, which is under equal conditions with them. You give way to the tram and the passenger car, which will go through the intersection at the same time, as their paths do not cross. The motorcyclist gives way to everyone, because he is on the secondary road. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Is driving on a motorway allowed in a vehicle whose speed, because of its technical condition, is less than 40 km/h?
Allowed
Allowed only in the rightmost lane
Prohibited
On motorways, vehicles whose speed according to their technical characteristics or condition is less than 40 km/h are prohibited. (ПДД clause 16.1)
Carrying a load is prohibited if it:
Sticks out more than 1 m beyond the vehicle's dimensions at the front or rear and is marked with identification signs
Covers the external lights, reflectors, registration plates and identification signs
Is placed on a passenger seat

According to ПДД clause 23.3, carrying a load is prohibited under the conditions listed in the second answer. A load sticking out more than 1 m beyond the vehicle's dimensions at the front or rear may be carried, but it must then be marked with the identification sign «Oversized vehicle», and in the hours of darkness and in conditions of insufficient visibility, with lights. (ПДД clause 23.4)
Is a vehicle allowed to drive to the place of repair or parking in the hours of darkness with its headlights and rear side lights not working (because of a fault)?
Allowed
Allowed only on roads with artificial lighting
Prohibited
With this fault, in the hours of darkness or in conditions of insufficient visibility, driving is prohibited, even to the place of repair or parking, whatever the road lighting. (ПДД clause 2.3.1)
When turning left, safety is ensured by turning along the path shown:
In the left picture
In the right picture
In both pictures

If the cars in both pictures have the same weight and speed, the centrifugal force trying to make the car skid is in theory smaller in the right picture, since the path has a larger radius. But the driver then has no margin (he comes out of the bend right at the edge of the carriageway), and not all factors acting on the car can always be taken into account. The path in the left picture is better, as it leaves a margin of carriageway width; you must, however, considerably reduce speed before entering the bend. (Vehicle driving technique)
How do you open the casualty's airway when preparing for cardiopulmonary resuscitation?
Lay the casualty on his back on a hard surface, tilt his head back, put one hand on his forehead and lift his chin with two fingers of the other hand
Lay the casualty on his side and tilt his head towards his chest. If there is mucus or vomit, clear it from the mouth.
Lay the casualty on his back and, without tilting his head back, squeeze his cheeks to part the lips and open the mouth. If there is mucus or vomit, clear it from the mouth.

An unconscious casualty lying on his back may suffocate because his tongue falls back, so the airway must be opened. Lay the casualty on his back on a hard surface, tilt his head back, put one hand on his forehead and lift his chin with two fingers of the other hand.
What manoeuvre does the passenger car driver intend to make?
Overtaking
Changing lanes followed by passing
Going around an obstacle

The passenger car driver is «changing lanes» into the parallel lane and then «passing» – moving faster than a vehicle travelling in the same direction. (ПДД clause 1.2, terms «Lane change», «Passing»)
This sign:
Shows the directions of travel at the intersection
Shows that the intersecting road has two lanes
Prohibits U-turns at the intersection
Warning sign 1.34.3 «Direction of turn» shows the directions of travel at a T-junction. (Road signs)
In a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t you may drive at:
Not more than 50 km/h
Not more than 70 km/h
Not more than 90 km/h

Plate 8.4.1 «Type of vehicle» under the sign makes the sign apply to lorries, including those with a trailer, with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 t. Your vehicle is not one of them, so you continue at the speed allowed for you – not more than 90 km/h, since this is outside a built-up area. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.3)
Which of these signs shows the length of the U-turn zone?
Only А
Only Б
А and Б

Sign «Б» 6.3.2 «U-turn zone» marks the place on a section of road where U-turns are allowed and its length – here not more than 15 m. The combination «А» – 6.3.1 «U-turn place» with plate 8.1.1 «Distance to object» – shows that 50 m beyond the signs there will be a place intended only for U-turns. The length of the U-turn zone is not specified here. (Road signs)
This marking shows:
A section of road where driving next to the pavement is prohibited
Places where any stopping is prohibited
Stops for route vehicles and taxi ranks
The yellow zigzag marking 1.17.1 marks stops for route vehicles and taxi ranks. (Horizontal road markings)
In which cases must you give way to a vehicle with special colour schemes on its outer surfaces?
If its driver has switched on a blue flashing beacon and a special sound signal
If its driver has switched on a blue flashing beacon
In all cases
To get priority, the emergency vehicle must switch on a blue flashing beacon and a special sound signal. (ПДД clause 3.1)
Does signalling with the direction indicators give priority?
Yes
Only when completing an overtaking manoeuvre
No
Signalling with the direction indicators does not give the driver priority and does not release him from taking precautions. (ПДД clause 8.2)
Are you allowed to turn right along the path shown in this situation?
Allowed
Prohibited

When turning right, the vehicle must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway, i.e. use the rightmost lane. Here you cannot, because a passenger car has stopped in that lane. You continue along the path shown. (ПДД clause 8.6)
May you make a U-turn?
Yes
Only along path А
Only along path Б
No
You are on a one-way road, where driving against the traffic is prohibited. You may not continue along the paths shown. (Road signs 5.6, 1.21)
In which cases, on two-way roads, is driving in the lane intended for oncoming traffic prohibited?
If it is separated by tram tracks
If it is separated by a central reservation
If it is separated by dividing marking 1.1 or 1.3, or by marking 1.11 with the broken line on the left
In all of the listed cases

On any two-way road, driving in the lane intended for oncoming traffic is prohibited if it is separated by tram tracks, a central reservation, marking 1.1, marking 1.3 or marking 1.11 with the broken line on the left. (ПДД clause 9.1(1)) ПДД amendments of 12 July 2017.
Are you allowed to overtake the lorry at the top of the hill?
Allowed
Allowed if the lorry's speed is not more than 30 km/h
Prohibited

The crest of the road limits visibility at the top of the hill. So overtaking is prohibited. (ПДД clause 11.4) Do not forget the main condition for overtaking: «the distance needed to overtake must never exceed half of the visible stretch of road».
Are you allowed to park the car at this place if the shoulder is narrow?
Allowed
Allowed only in daylight
Prohibited
Outside built-up areas, parking on the carriageway of roads marked with sign 2.1 «Priority road» is prohibited. (ПДД clause 12.5)
How should you act when turning right?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to tram А
Give way only to tram Б
Give way to both trams

To turn right you must cross the tram tracks. Both trams, like you, are allowed to move; they move «along the controller's arms». You give way to them, because when both have the right to move, the tram has priority over trackless vehicles. (ПДД clauses 6.10, 13.6)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Enter the intersection first and, giving way to the motorcycle, complete the turn
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule». You move first, because at first you have no obstruction on your right. Having entered the intersection, you stop just before turning left, because the motorcycle is on the right of your path. After the motorcycle has passed, you may complete the manoeuvre. The passenger car goes through the intersection last. (ПДД clause 13.11)
When going straight ahead you must give way:
Only to the passenger car
Only to the lorry
To both vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. You are on the secondary road, so you give way to both vehicles. (Road signs 2.4, 8.13; ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Which of the drivers is breaking the Rules?
The drivers of the lorry with a permitted maximum weight of 3 t and of the moped
Only the moped rider
Nobody

Mopeds are prohibited on motorways. Lorries with a permitted maximum weight of more than 2.5 t are also prohibited from driving in the leftmost lane of any road with three lanes in one direction. The lorry driver and the moped rider are breaking the rules. (ПДД clauses 9.4, 16.1)
When dazzled by the main-beam headlights of oncoming or following vehicles, the driver must:
Move right to the edge of the carriageway and stop
Switch on the hazard warning lights and, without changing lanes, reduce speed and stop
Sound the horn and stop
Try to act in the order set by the Rules: switch on the hazard warning lights and, without changing lanes, reduce speed and stop. (ПДД clause 19.2)
What types of administrative penalties may be applied to drivers for violating the Rules?
Only a warning or a fine
A warning, a fine, disqualification from driving, administrative arrest
A warning, a fine, disqualification from driving, confiscation of the instrument or object of the administrative offence, administrative arrest, compulsory community work

According to chapter 12 of the КоАП, all the types of penalties listed in the answers may be applied to drivers for violating the ПДД. The correct answer is the most complete one. (Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation)
Which of the driver's actions will reduce the centrifugal force arising in a bend?
Increasing speed
Reducing speed
Reducing the radius of the bend

Speed is the factor that has the greatest effect on centrifugal force: the force is proportional to the square of the speed. And it is the driver who sets the speed. Reducing it reduces the centrifugal force. That is why it is recommended to slow down before entering a bend. (Vehicle driving technique)
How does alcohol affect a driver's reaction time?
Reaction time decreases
Alcohol does not affect reaction time
Reaction time increases

At the wheel a driver needs more than just reactions, which become slower with alcohol. Most important is constantly assessing events and anticipating how they will develop. Under alcohol the brain gives wrong assessments – this is the main danger of driving while drunk. (Transport psychology)
A priority road is shown:
Only in the upper left picture
Only in the upper right picture
In both upper pictures
In all the pictures
In the upper left picture the priority road is marked with sign 5.1 «Motorway». In the upper right picture, with sign 2.3.2 «Secondary road joining». (Road signs)
At what distance before the slippery section of road is this sign placed in a built-up area?
Immediately before the start of the slippery section
In built-up areas, most warning signs are placed 50–100 m before the dangerous section. Sign 1.15 «Slippery road» is also placed at this distance. (Road signs)
Stopping in the zone of this sign is allowed:
Only for taxis with the taximeter switched on
Only for cars with the «Disabled» identification sign
For all of the listed vehicles
When sign 3.27 «No stopping» is used with plate 8.18 «Except disabled persons», motorised wheelchairs and cars marked with the «Disabled» sign may stop in its zone, in accordance with federal law.
Which of these signs is used to mark a campsite?
Only А
Only Б
Only В
Б and В
Service signs inform you where the corresponding facilities are. The signs shown: «Б» – 7.10 «Campsite»; «А» – 7.9 «Hotel or motel»; «В» – 7.11 «Rest area». (Road signs)
If the reversible traffic lights have switched off, you should:
Immediately move right into the neighbouring lane
Continue in the lane only up to the intersection
Continue in the lane if there are no oncoming vehicles

When the signals of the reversible traffic light above a lane marked on both sides with marking 1.9 are switched off, entering this lane is prohibited. You must move into the right lane. (ПДД clause 6.7, Horizontal road markings)
You are allowed to continue:
Only left
Only in the opposite direction
Left and in the opposite direction

The lit arrow of the additional section, sign 5.15.1 «Lane directions» and the markings all allow you, from the leftmost lane, to turn left and to make a U-turn to drive in the opposite direction. (Road signs, ПДД clause 6.3)
How must a towed car be marked if it has no hazard warning lights or they are faulty?
Fix the warning triangle on the rear of the towed car
Switch on the side lights
Switch on the rear fog light
If a towed motor vehicle has no hazard warning lights or they are faulty, the warning triangle must be fixed on its rear. (ПДД clause 7.3)
May the passenger car driver move off from the pavement in this situation?
Yes
Yes, if this does not obstruct the lorry
No
Before moving off, switch on the direction indicator for the corresponding direction. You may move off only after making sure it is safe and will not obstruct other road users. (ПДД clause 8.1)
The driver has accidentally driven past the courtyard entrance he needed. Is he allowed to reverse in order to then turn right?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited

Reversing is prohibited at stops. This manoeuvre is prohibited for you here, because you intend to do it at a stop for route vehicles, shown by sign 5.16 «Bus and trolleybus stop» and the yellow zigzag marking 1.17.1. (ПДД clauses 8.11, 8.12)
Which of the moped riders is positioned correctly in the lane?
Only moped rider A
Only moped rider Б
Both

Moped riders must ride along the right edge of the carriageway in single file, or in the cycle lane. Moped riders may also ride on the shoulder if this does not obstruct pedestrians. (ПДД clauses 9.4, 24.7)
After passing the car in the right lane, may you continue in the middle lane?
Yes
Yes, only if there is no oncoming traffic
No

Here the middle lane is used for traffic in both directions. It is intended only for overtaking, going around obstacles, turning left or making a U-turn. After overtaking you must move back into the rightmost lane (ПДД clause 9.3). After that you drive according to ПДД clause 9.4: «Outside built-up areas, drivers must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway». You can do so.
The drivers of which cars have broken the stopping rules?
Only car А
Cars А and Б
Cars А and В
All the cars

Stopping is prohibited on pedestrian crossings and closer than 5 m before them. The driver of car «А» clearly breaks the rules, as he is right next to the pedestrian crossing. The driver of car «Б» stopped beyond the crossing, which does not contradict the Rules. In a built-up area, as here, you may also stop on the left side of the road when there are no tram tracks in the middle of the carriageway. But since traffic on this road is two-way, the driver of car «В» also breaks the Rules by stopping right next to the pedestrian crossing. (ПДД clauses 12.1, 12.2 and 12.4)
How should you act when going straight ahead?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the tram
Wait for another signal from the traffic controller

The intersection is regulated. Trams move only «in the direction of the controller's arms», i.e. straight ahead. The tram driver may not turn right, so he waits for the controller's signal to change. You may continue straight ahead or right. You go through the intersection first. (ПДД clause 6.10)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the motorcycle
Only the passenger car
Nobody
The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule». Only the car is an obstruction on your right, so you must give way to it. (ПДД clause 13.11)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Give way to both vehicles
Give way only to the passenger car
Give way only to the bus

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go. You are on the secondary road. You give way to both vehicles. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
The signal for the train driver to stop is the following position of the arm or arms (by day with a piece of bright cloth or any clearly visible object, at night with a flare or a lamp):
Arms extended to the sides
A circular movement of the arm
The right arm raised
Both arms raised
The signal for the train driver to stop is a circular movement of the arm (by day with a piece of bright cloth or a clearly visible object, at night with a flare or a lamp). (ПДД clause 15.5, Note)
In a tunnel with artificial lighting you must have switched on:
Dipped headlights or side lights
Dipped headlights or daytime running lights
Dipped or main-beam headlights
Whatever the lighting in the tunnel, main-beam or dipped headlights must be switched on when entering it. (ПДД clause 19.1)
Criminal liability is provided for driving a vehicle while intoxicated, without causing grave harm to health or death, by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty:
For driving a vehicle while intoxicated
For refusing a lawful demand of an authorised official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication
For committing any of the listed offences
According to Article 264.1 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, criminal liability is provided in this situation for committing any of the listed offences.
Driving behind a lorry on a two-lane road, you have a chance to overtake. What do you do?
Get as close as possible to the vehicle being overtaken, then move into the oncoming lane and complete the manoeuvre
Move into the oncoming lane, then close in on the vehicle being overtaken and complete the manoeuvre
Both courses of action are allowed

A heavy lorry ahead is a «moving wall» that limits your view. Only by keeping your distance can you see far enough to overtake, inform the driver ahead in time and be seen by him, and if necessary abandon the overtaking in time and return to your lane. (Vehicle driving technique)
How is cardiopulmonary resuscitation of a casualty carried out?
Artificial respiration and pressing on the casualty's breastbone: first 1 mouth-to-mouth breath, then 15 presses on the breastbone
Pressing on the casualty's breastbone and artificial respiration: first 15 presses on the breastbone, then 1 mouth-to-mouth breath
Pressing on the casualty's breastbone and artificial respiration: first 30 presses on the breastbone, then 2 mouth-to-mouth breaths

During cardiopulmonary resuscitation the casualty must lie on a hard surface. Resuscitation begins with pressing on the casualty's breastbone with the hands. After 30 presses, artificial respiration is given – 2 mouth-to-mouth breaths. For artificial respiration it is recommended to use the «mouth-device-mouth» device included in the first-aid kit.
What does the term «Insufficient visibility» mean?
Visibility of the road of less than 100 m near dangerous bends and crests
Visibility of the road of less than 150 m at night
Visibility of the road of less than 300 m in fog, rain, snowfall, etc., and at twilight
«Insufficient visibility» is visibility of the road of less than 300 m in fog, rain, snowfall and the like, and at twilight. ПДД clause 1.2, term «Insufficient visibility».
At the next intersection you may continue:
Only in direction Б
In directions А and Б
In any of the directions shown

Here sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead» is placed beyond an intersection of carriageways, i.e. at the start of a section of road. In this case it applies up to the nearest intersection. So you may continue in all the directions shown. (Road signs)
Which of these signs allow driving at 60 km/h?
Only Б
Б and В
All of them
Signs «Б» – 4.6 «Minimum speed limit» and «В» – 6.2 «Recommended speed». (Road signs)
Which of the drivers has broken the parking rules?
The motorcyclist and the lorry driver
Only the motorcyclist
Only the lorry driver
Nobody

Drivers of any lorries are prohibited from stopping and parking partly on a pavement next to the carriageway. This lorry driver clearly breaks the Rules. The passenger car driver and the motorcyclist fully met the Rules, according to sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» and plate 8.6.3. (ПДД clause 12.2)
You may go around the obstacle:
Only along path А
Only along path Б
Along either of the paths shown
Signs take precedence over markings. So according to sign 4.2.2 «Pass obstacle on the left», you must continue along path «А». (Road signs, Horizontal road markings)
What does the combination of red and yellow traffic light signals mean?
The traffic light is faulty
The green signal will soon come on
The red signal will soon come on
The combination of red and yellow signals prohibits movement and informs that the green signal is about to come on. (ПДД clause 6.2)
At what distance from the vehicle must the warning triangle be set out in this situation?
At least 15 m
At least 20 m
At least 30 m

This is outside a built-up area, so the warning triangle is set out further away than in a built-up area. You choose the distance according to the situation, but it must be at least 30 m. (ПДД clause 7.2)
Whom must you give way to when turning into the courtyard?
Only the oncoming car
The oncoming car and the pedestrians
Nobody

When turning left outside an intersection, the driver of a trackless vehicle must give way to oncoming vehicles, users of personal mobility devices and pedestrians whose path he crosses. (ПДД clauses 8.3, 8.8)
To reverse safely out of a parking place with limited visibility, you must:
Sound the horn
Switch on the hazard warning lights
Ask other people for help
Reversing is allowed provided the manoeuvre is safe and does not obstruct other road users. If necessary, the driver must ask other people for help. (ПДД clause 8.12)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue in a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t after entering the road on the left?
60 km/h
70 km/h
90 km/h
On all roads of a built-up area marked with sign 5.23.1 on a white background, the speed must not exceed 60 km/h. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.2)
How should you act in this situation?
Give way to the oncoming car
Go first
Act by mutual agreement with the oncoming driver
When passing oncoming vehicles is difficult, the driver on whose side there is an obstacle must give way. Here you have priority – you go first. (ПДД clause 11.7)
The drivers of which cars have not broken the stopping rules?
Only car Б
Only car В
Cars А and Б
Cars А and В

This is in a built-up area on a road marked with sign 5.5 «One-way road». On such a road a passenger car may also stop and park on the left side in the direction of travel (place «А»). At place «В» you may not stop or park, as you would be within the zone of sign 3.27 «No stopping» with plate 8.2.3 «Zone of effect», which shows the end of this sign's zone. The car may be parked at place «А» or «Б». (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.1)
You must give way to other road users:
Only when turning left or making a U-turn
Only when turning right
In both of the listed cases

When turning right you must give way to the pedestrians. When turning left or making a U-turn, to the tram, which has priority under equal conditions. There is no obstruction when going straight ahead. The correct answer: in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 13.1, 13.6)
You intend to continue straight ahead. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the lorry, as it is approaching from the right
Give way to the lorry, as it is on the priority road

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You have an obstruction on your right; the lorry has priority. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Both vehicles
The car with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on
Nobody

The emergency vehicle with a blue flashing light and siren switched on clearly has priority. All others must let it pass through the intersection unobstructed. After it you go, since you are on the priority road and have priority over the lorry on the secondary road. (ПДД clauses 3.1, 13.9)
After a forced stop on a level crossing, if there are passengers in the vehicle, the driver must:
Get the people out immediately
Get the people out if the measures taken do not allow the vehicle to be removed from the crossing
Get the people out when a train appears
After a forced stop on a level crossing, the driver must immediately get the people out and take measures to clear the crossing. (ПДД clause 15.5)
When stopping and parking on unlit sections of road in the hours of darkness, you must:
Switch on the side lights
Switch on the dipped headlights
Set out the warning triangle
When stopping and parking in the hours of darkness on unlit sections of road, and in conditions of insufficient visibility, the vehicle's side lights must be switched on. (ПДД clause 19.3)
In which case is the operation of a car permitted?
The windscreen wipers provided by the manufacturer are faulty or missing
The windscreen washers provided by the manufacturer are faulty or missing
The window lifter does not work

The «List of faults» prohibits operation with the listed faults of the wipers and washers. The working order of the window lifter is not covered by this list, so operation is allowed. («List of faults», clause 4.5)
Along what path does a passenger car's trailer move through a bend?
Further from the centre of the bend than the car's path
Along the car's path
Closer to the centre of the bend than the car's path
Any trailer, including a passenger car's trailer, moves closer to the centre of the bend than the car's path.
The driver's average reaction time is generally taken to be:
About 0.5 seconds
About 1 second
About 2 seconds

Reaction time differs from driver to driver and is not constant. Experiments have shown that drivers' average reaction time is about 1 second. To get a feel for a second, say «twenty-two» in Russian – a second has passed. If your own reaction time is longer, compensate by reducing your average speed. Driver reaction, «lost time», minimum safe distance and overtaking are covered in more detail in the manual «Автошкола РФ» («ЭКСМО» publishing house).
At an intersection, the priority road is:
A paved road in relation to an unpaved road
An asphalt-concrete road in relation to a cobbled road
A road with three or more lanes in relation to a road with two lanes
When there are no signs marking the priority road, a paved road is the priority road in relation to an unpaved one. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Priority road»)
Are you allowed to drive onto the bridge at the same time as the motorcyclist?
Allowed
Allowed if you do not hinder him
Prohibited
This sign (2.6) prohibits entering a narrow section of road only if this would hinder oncoming traffic. (Road signs)
The drivers of which cars have broken the parking rules?
Only car А
Only car Б
Cars А and Б

Sign 3.27 «No stopping» applies up to the nearest intersection – here the junction with the road on the left. A car may be parked at place «Б». Only the driver of car «А» breaks the stopping and parking rules. (Road signs, ПДД clause 12.1)
Which of these plates make the signs they are used with apply to lorries with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t?
Only Б
Only В
Б and В
All of them

Plates 8.4.1 (А) and 8.4.3.2 (Б) «Type of vehicle» apply: «А» to lorries, including those with a trailer, with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 t; «Б» to passenger cars and lorries with a permitted maximum weight of up to 3.5 t. Plate 8.6.1 (В) «Method of parking the vehicle» makes sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» apply to ALL vehicles. So only plates «Б» and «В» concern lorries with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t. (Road signs)
The right lane is intended for:
Any buses
All buses and trolleybuses
Buses and trolleybuses that are route vehicles, school buses and passenger taxis, as well as cyclists

In the rightmost lane, marked with marking 1.23.1 (the letter «А») and sign 5.14.1 «Lane for route vehicles», of the vehicles in the answers, the following may drive: buses and trolleybuses running on set routes with marked stops (route vehicles), school buses, passenger taxis and cyclists. (ПДД clause 1.2, Road signs, Horizontal road markings)
What should the passenger car driver do when an emergency service vehicle is approaching?
Continue in the left lane
Move into the right lane
Stop on the right by the pavement

You must give way to emergency service vehicles travelling with a blue flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on, letting them pass unobstructed. The passenger car driver should move into the right lane and continue. (ПДД clause 3.2)
The car driver's arm bent at the elbow is a signal informing you that he intends to:
Turn right
Continue straight ahead
Stop to give way to the motorcycle
A right-turn signal is the right arm extended to the side, or the left arm extended to the side and bent upwards at the elbow at a right angle (as here). (ПДД clause 8.1)
When turning left you may continue:
Only along path А
Only along path В
Along any of the paths shown

When turning left at an intersection you may choose any path. The main condition: when leaving the intersection of carriageways, your vehicle must not end up on the side for oncoming traffic. (ПДД clause 8.6)
If the paths of vehicles cross and the order of passage is not set by the Rules, you should:
Give way to the vehicle approaching from the right
Give way to the vehicle approaching from the left
Act by mutual agreement between the drivers

In cases not covered by the Rules – for example in car parks, at filling stations, in factory yards, in fields, meadows, etc. – the order of passage is set by the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. (ПДД clause 8.9)
In which cases, on roads whose carriageway is divided by marking lines, must drivers keep strictly to the lanes?
Only in heavy traffic
Only if the lanes are marked with solid lines
In all cases
When there are markings, you must keep strictly to the marked lanes in all cases. (ПДД clause 9.7)
The driver of the vehicle being overtaken:
Must reduce speed
Must not increase speed
May act at his own discretion
The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is prohibited from hindering the overtaking by increasing speed or in any other way. (ПДД clause 11.3)
Are you allowed to stop at the indicated place to drop off passengers?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited

In built-up areas, on roads with one lane in each direction and no tram tracks in the middle, stopping and parking are allowed not only on the right side but also on the left side in the direction of travel. Stopping to drop off and pick up passengers is allowed at stops for route vehicles marked with zigzag marking 1.17.1, if it does not obstruct them. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 12.1, 12.4)
You intend to turn right. What do you do?
Wait for another signal from the traffic controller
Give way to the passenger car making a U-turn
Go through the intersection first
From the side of the traffic controller's extended right arm, trackless vehicles may only turn right. The car making a U-turn, following the «right-hand rule», gives way to you. (ПДД clause 6.10)
In which case must you let the tram pass?
When turning left after moving onto the tram tracks in the same direction
When going straight ahead
In both of the listed cases

You and the tram are on the same road under equal conditions. In that case the tram always has priority over trackless vehicles. You must give way to the tram in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 13.11)
How should you act when turning left?
Give way to both vehicles
Give way only to the lorry
Go through the intersection first

The intersection is unregulated and of unequal roads. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go through. The lorry goes first; you give way to it. The passenger car goes last. (ПДД clauses 13.3, 13.9, 13.12)
You must give way to the lorry:
Only when turning right
Only when turning left
In both of the listed cases
You are leaving a residential zone, as shown by sign 5.22 «End of residential zone». You give way to other road users – here to the lorry, in both of the listed cases. (Road signs, ПДД clause 17.3)
In which cases must dipped headlights or daytime running lights be switched on in daylight?
Only when driving outside a built-up area
Only when driving in a built-up area
In both of the listed cases
Dipped headlights or daytime running lights must be switched on in daylight in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 19.5)
Administrative liability is set for violating the Road Traffic Regulations or vehicle operating rules that caused:
Minor harm to a person's health or insignificant material damage
Minor or moderate harm to a person's health
Minor or moderate harm to a person's health or material damage

Under Article 12.24 of the КоАП, administrative liability is set for violations of the ПДД or vehicle operating rules that caused minor or moderate harm to a person's health. (Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation)
How should emergency braking be done on a slippery road if the car has no anti-lock braking system?
Press the brake pedal all the way and hold it until the car stops completely
Press the brake pedal while using the parking brake
Brake by pressing the brake pedal intermittently, without letting the wheels lock

Emergency (not normal) braking on a slippery surface should be combined: «engine braking» (without disengaging the clutch until the speed has dropped considerably) and intermittent pressing of the brake pedal without letting the wheels lock completely, which would cause sliding and a longer braking distance. The main mistake in this case is holding the pedal down for a long time, i.e. not knowing how to brake in pulses (intermittently).
How does a driver perceive his car's speed after driving fast for a long time on a flat road?
It seems lower than it really is
Perception of speed does not change
It seems higher than it really is

The driver judges his speed by how fast objects in his field of view move. After long, monotonous driving, the speed seems lower than it really is. To control your speed in such situations, check the speedometer more often than usual.
Category «B» covers cars:
With a permitted maximum weight of not more than 2.5 t and not more than 8 seats in addition to the driver's seat
With a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t and not more than 8 seats in addition to the driver's seat
With a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t and not more than 16 seats in addition to the driver's seat

Under Article 25 clause 1 of the Federal Law «On Road Traffic Safety», category «B» covers cars with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t and not more than 8 seats in addition to the driver's seat.
Which of these signs are placed immediately before a level crossing?
Only А
Only Б
Only В
А and В

Of the signs shown, only sign «В» 1.3.2 «Multi-track railway» is placed immediately before a level crossing. Note that when a level crossing has no barriers, signs 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 mark its limits. The combinations of signs «А» and «Б» are placed outside built-up areas 150–300 m before the crossing. (Road signs)
You are allowed to make a U-turn:
Only along path А
Only along path Б
Along either of the paths shown

At an intersection marked with sign 4.3 «Roundabout», traffic moves round the circle in the direction of the arrows. Path «А» goes against the traffic, which is not allowed. To make a U-turn you must enter the intersection and drive round the circle. The U-turn may be made only along path «Б». (Road signs)
May you park the car beyond the overpass?
Yes
Yes, not closer than 5 m from the overpass support
No
At this place parking is prohibited by sign 3.28 «No parking», which applies up to the nearest intersection. An overpass does not end the effect of this sign. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to move into the reversible-traffic lane in this situation?
Allowed
Allowed only to turn left or make a U-turn
Prohibited

The green arrow of the reversible traffic light allows driving in the reversible lane. You may cross the double broken marking line 1.9 to drive in it, i.e. in your direction. (ПДД clause 6.7, Horizontal road markings)
You are allowed to go:
Only in direction А
In directions А and Б
In any of the directions shown

The traffic controller's signals apply to the intersection of carriageways where he stands. Let us assume he is at the first intersection. From the side of his extended arm, trackless vehicles may only turn right. You may continue along path «А». (ПДД clause 6.10)
Which direction indicators must you switch on when making a U-turn along this path?
Only the right one
Only the left one
First the right one, then the left one when moving away from the pavement

If, when making a U-turn outside an intersection, the carriageway is too narrow to do it from the outermost position (under clause 8.5), it may be made from the right edge of the carriageway (but not from the middle of the carriageway for your direction). A U-turn along this path is made on a narrow road. Be very careful and do not do it at high speed: when you first switch on the right indicator, the driver behind may think you are stopping. After switching on the left indicator, check again that there is no obstruction, since during the U-turn you must give way to vehicles in both directions. (ПДД clauses 8.1, 8.5, 8.8)
The situation in which the driver of the vehicle in the right lane must give way when changing lanes is shown:
In the left picture
In the right picture
In both pictures

When changing lanes at the same time, drivers follow the «right-hand rule». That is the situation in the right picture: the car in the right lane has priority. In the left picture only one vehicle changes lanes: when you change lanes, you give way to vehicles travelling in the same direction without changing direction. The «owner of the lane» has priority then. The correct answer is the left picture. (ПДД clause 8.4)
Is the passenger car driver allowed to reverse to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited
Reversing at stops for route vehicles is prohibited. (ПДД clauses 8.11, 8.12)
In this situation, to continue straight ahead you have the right to:
Pass the lorry on the right
Continue only after the lorry has turned left
Do either of the listed actions

Here you may choose: either pass the lorry on the right, or wait until the lane you are in is clear, so as to continue without unnecessary lane changes. (ПДД clauses 1.2, terms «Lane change», «Passing», 8.4)
Is overtaking prohibited on and under bridges, overpasses and flyovers?
Prohibited
Prohibited only under bridges, overpasses and flyovers
Prohibited only if there is a solid marking line
Allowed
Overtaking is prohibited on and under bridges, overpasses and flyovers. (ПДД clause 11.4)
May you stop in the tunnel to pick up a passenger?
Yes
Yes, if you are driving a passenger taxi
No
Definitely not, because stopping is prohibited in tunnels and under flyovers, bridges and overpasses. (ПДД clause 12.4)
How should you act when turning right?
Stop before the stop line and, after letting the pedestrians pass, turn right
Enter the intersection and stop before the pedestrian crossing to let the pedestrians pass
Continue without stopping at the intersection
When turning right or left at any intersection (regulated or unregulated), the driver must give way to pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road he is turning into. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 13.1)
In which direction will you have priority?
Only when turning right
Only when turning left
In any of the listed directions

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule». You have no obstruction on your right in any of the listed directions. You go through the intersection first. (ПДД clause 13.11)
You intend to continue straight ahead. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the tram

The intersection is of unequal roads. You and the tram are on the priority road. The «right-hand rule» does not apply here. Under equal conditions the tram has priority over trackless vehicles. You give way to the tram. (ПДД clause 13.11, Road signs)
On which sections of a motorway is reversing prohibited?
Only at entries and exits
Only at stops for route vehicles
Along the whole length of the road
Reversing on a motorway is prohibited along the whole length of the road. (ПДД clause 16.1)
On which roads are moped riders prohibited from turning left or making a U-turn?
On roads with tram traffic
On roads with more than one lane in the given direction
On all of the listed roads

Moped riders may ride along the right edge of the carriageway in single file. They are prohibited from turning left or making a U-turn on roads with tram tracks and on roads with more than one lane in the given direction. (ПДД clauses 24.7, 24.8)
With which fault is driving prohibited during rain or snowfall?
The windscreen wipers do not work in the set mode
The windscreen wiper on the driver's side does not work
The windscreen washers do not work
Driving with the wiper on the driver's side not working is prohibited during rain or snowfall. (ПДД clause 2.3.1)
As speed increases in a bend, the centrifugal force:
Does not change
Increases in proportion to the speed
Increases in proportion to the square of the speed

Centrifugal force depends on the car's weight and the radius of the bend, and is proportional to the square of the speed. The driver cannot change the weight of the moving car. He can slightly increase the radius of the bend, but the speed – the factor with the greatest effect on this force – depends entirely on him. That is why it is recommended to slow down before entering a bend. (Vehicle driving technique)
How is first aid given for fractured limbs if there are no transport splints or materials to improvise them?
The arm, stretched along the body, is bandaged to the torso. The legs are bandaged to each other with soft cloth placed between them.
The arm, bent at the elbow, is put in a triangular sling and bandaged to the torso. The legs are bandaged to each other, always with soft cloth placed between them.
The arm, bent at the elbow, is put in a triangular sling and bandaged to the torso. The legs are pressed tightly together and bandaged.

In this situation, the arm bent at the elbow is put in a triangular sling and bandaged to the torso. The legs are bandaged to each other, always with soft cloth placed between them. The key point is that soft cloth must be placed between the limbs.
How many intersections of carriageways does this intersection have?
One
Two
Four
This intersection has two intersections of carriageways, formed by the central reservation. (ПДД clause 1.2)
These signs warn of the approach:
To a place where road works are being carried out
To a level crossing with a barrier
To a level crossing without a barrier

Sign 1.1 «Level crossing with barrier» and sign 1.4.1 «Approach to a level crossing» are on one post, since outside built-up areas they are placed 150–300 m before the dangerous section. Outside built-up areas, sign 1.1 is always repeated. These signs warn of the approach to a level crossing with barriers. (Road signs)

Which of these signs do not apply to vehicles driven by people with group I or II disabilities, or carrying such people or disabled children, if the vehicles display the «Disabled» identification sign?
А and Б
Б and Г
Б, В and Г
All of them

Of the signs shown, the ones that do not apply to vehicles driven by people with group I or II disabilities, or carrying such people or disabled children, with the «Disabled» identification sign, are sign «Б» 3.2 «No vehicles» and sign «Г» 3.28 «No parking». (Road signs)
From the leftmost lane you may continue:
Only left
Only in the opposite direction
Left or in the opposite direction

Lane direction signs that allow a left turn from the leftmost lane also allow a U-turn. Driving in the leftmost lane, according to sign 5.15.2 «Lane direction», you may turn left or make a U-turn to continue in the opposite direction. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to stop at this place?
Allowed
Allowed only by driving onto the pavement
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited
The yellow broken marking line 1.10 marks places where parking is prohibited. Since 1 March 2023 it is used only on its own. Nothing prohibits stopping, i.e. it is allowed. (Horizontal road markings)
Priority over other road users belongs to the driver of a car:
Only with a blue or white-moon flashing beacon switched on
Only with an orange or yellow flashing beacon switched on
Only with a blue (blue and red) flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on
Any of the listed
To get priority, an emergency vehicle must use a blue, or blue and red, flashing beacon together with a special sound signal. (ПДД clause 3.1)
You intend to stop just beyond the intersection. Where must you switch on the right direction indicator?
Before entering the intersection, to warn other drivers in advance that you are stopping
Only after entering the intersection
It does not matter where, since turning right is prohibited

The answer needs a clarification. Each driver follows only the signs on his own road. In this situation the passenger car driver knows you have priority – you can tell from his actions; you are sure he is giving way. If you signal before the intersection, he will clearly take it to mean that you are turning right. Signalling just after entering the intersection may also be misunderstood – for example, that you were slow to decide but will still turn right. So switch on the indicator in the intersection, but not right at the start of entering it. Then the mandatory condition is met: the signal will not mislead other road users. (ПДД clause 8.2)
When leaving the road for an adjacent territory on the right, you:
Have priority over other road users
Must give way only to the pedestrians
Must give way only to the cyclist
Must give way to the pedestrians and the cyclist
When leaving the road for an adjacent territory, you give way to the cyclist, the pedestrians and users of personal mobility devices whose path you cross. (ПДД clause 8.3)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn while driving uphill?
Allowed
Allowed only if visibility of the road is 100 m or more
Prohibited
The crest of the road limits visibility. U-turns are prohibited where visibility of the road in at least one direction is less than 100 m. (ПДД clause 8.11)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue when towing a broken-down motor vehicle?
50 km/h
70 km/h
90 km/h
When towing, the speed must not exceed 50 km/h, which is the maximum. (ПДД clause 10.4)
May you start overtaking?
Yes
Yes, if the overtaking is completed before the intersection
No
